internalOnly.title: [쿠팡] 디지털 미디어 플래너 (대형광고주 담당)
internalOnly.description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. ( 임직원 추천은 Link 로 진행 )
 This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link )
 지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘ 사내 공모 지원서 양식 ’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정 으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.
 To apply, please complete the attached ‘ Internal Transfer Request Form ’ and submit it via your Coupang email address . 
 사내 공모 정책: [ Link ]
 Internal Transfer Policy: [ Link ] 
 회사 소개 
 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다. 
 쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다. 
 쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (High-tech), 초연결사회 (Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요. 
 조직 소개 
 쿠팡 광고사업부(쿠팡 Ads)는 세계 최고의 광고 솔루션을 제공하는 조직을 지향하며, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Operation, Product Management, Design, 그리고 Account Management 팀 등으로 구성되어 있습니다. 각 분야의 전문가가 모인 광고사업부는 광고주의 입장에서 어떻게 하면 비즈니스를 성장시킬 수 있을지 늘 함께 고민합니다.
 쿠팡 Ads Brand Key Account Management팀은 Coupang의 매출 증진 지원 및 고객 경험 다양성 확대를 위해 영업전략에 기반하여 신규, 중/대형 seller를 발굴, 기존 Seller 대상의 파트너십 관리 및 실적관리를 위한 주도적인 역할을 수행하고, 광고주의 매출 증대를 위해, 비즈니스 타입별 운영에 도움을 주고 광고캠페인 최적화를 지원합니다.
 업무내용 
 광고주의 목적/KPI 달성을 위해 쿠팡 전체 광고 상품을 활용, 최적의 미디어플랜 개발
 시장과 광고주의 니즈에 대한 깊은 이해를 바탕으로 광고 상품 및 시스템 구축에 참여
 광고 개선을 위해 실적 데이터 분석, 데이터 중심 인사이트 제공
 유통구조(직매입, 오픈마켓)에 대한 기본 지식 필요
 자격 요건 
 5년 이상 경험이 있으신 분으로, 카테고리 트렌드 분석, 전략 제안이 가능하신 분
 미디어 플랫폼/광고주 마케팅팀/에이전시에서의 광고주/에이전시 직접대면 (1:1) 광고 컨설팅/파트너십/영업 경험을 가지고 계신 분 혹은 광고 경험이 없으시더라도 유통사 MD 경험 혹은 광고 대행사 이력 혹은 제조사, 브랜드사에서 쿠팡 영업(상품 판매, 광고운영)을 진행해본 경험이 있는 분
 리테일 생태계에 대한 심층적인 이해를 바탕으로 한 기획/운영/리포트까지의 업무프로세스에 대한 구체적인 지식을 가지고 계시는 분.
 효과적인 커뮤니케이션, 프레젠테이션 및 협상 능력으로 복잡한 아이디어를 비즈니스 파트너에게 간단명료한 용어로 전달할 수 있는 능력을 가지신 분
 우대 사항 
 데이터 분석에 능하고, 분석결과를 활용한 광고 마케팅 전략 수립 능력이 있으신 분
 엑셀, 파워포인트 등 MS 오피스 툴 활용에 능하신 분
 쿠팡 광고를 활용한 미디어플랜 제시가 가능하신 분
 근로조건 
 고용형태: 정규직 (수습기간 12주)
 급여: 면접 후 결정
 근무지: 쿠팡 구의 본사(이스트폴 타워)
 근무일정: 월 ~ 금 / 9:30 ~18:30
 전형 절차 및 안내 사항 
 전형절차 
 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다. 
 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다. 
 참고사항 
 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다. 
 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다. 
 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다. 
 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다 . 
 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.
 개인정보 처리방침 
 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/ 
 서류반환정책 
 본고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다. 
 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다. 
 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 ( recruitingops@coupang.com ) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다. 
 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다. 
 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.
 반드시 첨부된 ‘ 사내공모지원서 양식 ’ 을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다 . 
 Please complete the attached Internal Transfer Request Form and submit. 
 반드시 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 지원 해 주시기 바랍니다 . 
 Please make sure to apply with your Coupang e-mail address .

internalOnly.description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. ( 임직원 추천은 Link 로 진행 )
 This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link )

 Internal Transfer Policy: [ Link ]

 쿠팡이 추구하는 “쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?”라는 가치는 가장 기본적인 판매자 영입과 상품 구색 확장에서 출발합니다. Account Manager는 바로 이 성장의 중심에서 쿠팡의 비즈니스 핵심을 경험하고, 영업 전문가로서의 커리어를 폭발적으로 확장할 수 있습니다.
 신사업의 빠른 성장을 위해 솔선수범하고 적극적인 태도로 쿠팡과 함께 성장할 인재를 기다립니다.
 업무 내용 
 신규 판매자 활성화 & 온보딩: 최근 가입 후 아직 판매 활동이 없는 판매자를 타겟팅하여 적극적인 영업 및 프로모션 제안
 시즈널리티에 따른 비즈니스 대응: 시즌별 비즈니스 환경 변화를 빠르게 포착하여 판매자가 빠르게 판매활동을 할 수 있도록 세일즈 전략 실행
 판매자 컨설팅: 쿠팡의 정책과 프로모션을 활용해 판매자가 플랫폼에서 성공적으로 정착하고 성장할 수 있도록 밀착 컨설팅
 자격 요건 
 학사 이상의 학위를 보유하신 분
 뚜렷한 목표의식과 성과 지향적인 태도로 주도적으로 업무에 임하시는 분
 대면 또는 비대면 환경에서 영업, 세일즈, 또는 고객 응대 경험을 보유하신 분
 플랫폼 비즈니스와 세일즈 직무에 대한 관심이 높고, 지속적으로 역량과 커리어를 개발하고 싶은 분
 우대 사항 
 세일즈 및 영업 업무 경력 1년 이상 보유하신 분
 비대면 (전화) 영업 경험이 있으신 분
 엑셀 활용 능력을 갖추신 분
 전형 절차 및 안내 사항 
 전형 절차 
 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
 참고 사항 
 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
 개인정보 처리방침 
 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/ 
 서류 반환 정책 
 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 ( recruitingops@coupang.com ) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다. 
 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

internalOnly.title: Director, Enterprise Planning & Performance (IBP)
internalOnly.description:
**Internal Job Posting** 
This posting is intended for current Vital Farms employees. If you are not an employee, please visit our careers page to view available opportunities and follow the appropriate application process. 
 Finding the right place to grow your career isn’t (over) easy, so we’re here to help by sharing a few reasons why the grass is greener at Vital Farms. We think you’ll appreciate our focus on Conscious Capitalism, which drives business decisions that benefit all our stakeholders (leading to even better business results). You might be drawn to our innovative approach and refusal to settle for the “way things have always been done.” Or you could find it exciting to grow your skills while working for an industry-leading brand. Whether you’re into our values, our brand, or our egg- cellent puns, we hope you ’ll join our Crew and help us change the world 108 square feet at a time! 
 At Vital Farms, we’re proud of the diverse communities we serve and the stakeholders who help bring our purpose to life. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative environment where every crew member feels valued. We see this as one of our greatest strengths - and your role is key to helping us build on it. 
 Your Role: 
 The Director, Integrated Business Planning (IBP) owns and facilitates Vital Farms’ established IBP process and advances its maturity and business impact. Partnering with next-level leaders (NLL) and functional leaders, this leader integrates commercial, operations, and financial plans across the rolling 36-month horizon to identify gaps and develop enterprise options. Together, they clarify tradeoffs and the cost and value of flexibility, align on one enterprise plan, and establish triggers to adapt. 
 Reporting to the Sr. Director, Operations Development, this role is an enterprise process owner, integrator, and facilitator. Functions own their plans, analyses, scenarios, recommendations, and execution: Demand Planning, within Sales Strategy, owns the demand plan; Supply Chain Planning (SCP) owns the integrated supply plan across the rolling 0–18+ month horizon; and Finance owns the financial outlook. The Director maintains IBP standards and governance, facilitates executive engagement, and supports business leaders in guiding discussions and decisions within agreed decision rights. 
 Following significant redesign and implementation, IBP has reached an intermediate level of maturity, with functional reviews in place. The mandate is to build on this foundation through deeper NLL engagement, clear functional ownership at each process step, and stronger scenario planning, performance measurement, and advanced analytics that create enterprise optionality and support timely, accountable decisions. 
 What You'll Do: 
 Lead and advance the IBP process 
 Own and facilitate the rolling 36-month Integrated Business Planning process, maintaining its standards, governance, and continued maturation. 
 Facilitate the monthly cycle across Product/Portfolio Review, Demand Review, Supply Review, Integrated Reconciliation, and Management Business Review, partnering with NLL so each forum produces decision-ready inputs, clear decisions, owners, and follow-through. 
 Advance standards, decision rights, inputs, outputs, KPIs, and meeting effectiveness while preserving what is already working and avoiding unnecessary process churn. 
 Govern the IBP maturity roadmap, including 2027 priorities for alignment, performance measurement, scenario planning, advanced analytics (including evaluation of AI), integrated planning across the rolling 36-month horizon, and connections to S&OE and AOP. 
 Partner with NLL and functional owners to define preparation, analysis, recommendations, presentation, and follow-through at each process step, so reviews are function-owned while IBP provides governance, integration, and enterprise consistency. 
 Continuously improve the process based on business performance, participant feedback, and evolving enterprise needs. 
 Integrate functional plans into one enterprise view 
 Create connectivity across Commercial, Operations, Finance, strategy, and AOP without duplicating the planning work owned by those functions. 
 Partner with Sales Strategy and Demand Planning to bring a clear, assumption-based demand plan and its risks and opportunities into IBP. 
 Partner with SCP to bring the integrated supply plan, constraints, farm and network implications, options, and recommendations into Supply Review. SCP owns the rolling 0–18+ month supply plan; IBP owns cross-functional integration and enterprise decision forums across the rolling 36-month horizon. 
 Partner with Finance to reconcile operational and commercial assumptions to the financial outlook and quantify the value, risk, and tradeoffs associated with scenarios. 
 Connect the strategic plan, AOP, commercial plan, and operations plan so longer-range commitments and near-term actions reinforce one another. 
 Maintain an integrated view of assumptions, gaps, risks, opportunities, and decisions rather than acting as the owner of every underlying number. 
 Enable decisions through scenarios, optionality, and strong facilitation 
 Partner with functional owners to turn complex planning inputs into focused, decision-ready executive conversations. 
 Identify material gaps to strategic and financial targets, clarify the decision required, and ensure the right owners develop fact-based options. 
 Facilitate functional development of practical base, upside, downside, and gap-closure scenarios, making tradeoffs across growth, service, capacity, supply, cost, margin, inventory, cash, and risk visible. 
 Distinguish operational planning decisions from enterprise tradeoffs: functional teams own their plans and recommendations; IBP enables decisions when choices span functions, materially affect targets, or require executive alignment. 
 Facilitate constructive debate, surface misalignment early, and prevent short-term exceptions from consuming the rolling 36-month IBP agenda unless they create material longer-term implications. 
 Enable functional leaders to bring concise, financially grounded narratives to leadership and executive forums that clarify what changed, why it matters, the options considered, the recommended path, and the decision required; bring their perspectives together into a coherent enterprise view. 
 Build enterprise optionality by clarifying the cost and value of flexibility and establishing triggers to commit, act, or adapt as conditions change. 
 Strengthen governance, accountability, and execution 
 Ensure decisions made through IBP translate into coordinated action and measurable outcomes. 
 Define and uphold decision rights, escalation thresholds, calendars, templates, and quality standards across the IBP cycle. 
 Maintain a transparent decision and action log, including owners, timing, expected value, retained options, review triggers, dependencies, and closure. 
 Ensure approved decisions flow back into demand, supply, financial, and execution plans, with clear connections to SCP and S&OE where applicable. 
 Define and govern business-performance and planning-health KPIs across the IBP cycle; monitor plan performance, bias, adherence, risk realization, and decision effectiveness, and use insights to improve both the process and future choices. 
 Lead through influence across NLL, senior leaders, and functional teams, creating shared accountability for enterprise outcomes. 
 Build sustainable IBP capability 
 Develop the organizational understanding and behaviors required for IBP to operate as a business management process, not a planning department. 
 Coach NLL, functional review owners, and participants on effective plan ownership, assumptions, scenarios, risk/opportunity thinking, and decision preparation. 
 Clarify the interfaces among IBP, Demand Planning, SCP, Finance, AOP, and S&OE so work occurs once, at the appropriate level, with clean handoffs. 
 Promote a shared-facts culture, using data to challenge assumptions while balancing analytical rigor with practical business judgment. 
 Partner with functional and data teams to evaluate fit-for-purpose tools, advanced analytics, and AI use cases based on value and feasibility, strengthening decision quality without allowing technology to lead the process. 
 What Success Looks Like: 
 IBP forums consistently focus on material risks, opportunities, scenarios, and enterprise decisions across the rolling 36-month horizon rather than detailed short-term execution. 
 Demand, supply, and financial plans are visibly connected, with differences in assumptions identified and resolved. 
 NLL and functional leaders consistently prepare and present decision-ready plans, alternatives, and recommendations; the IBP team owns integration, process integrity, and decision effectiveness. 
 Decisions are timely, fact-based, financially grounded, clearly documented, and translated into updated functional plans and execution. 
 Repeatable scenarios clarify tradeoffs, the cost and value of flexibility, and triggers to act or adapt, surfacing options before lead times or commitments limit choices. 
 Leaders trust the process as the primary forum for aligning the enterprise plan and managing delivery against strategic targets. 
 IBP maturity advances through governed KPIs and measurable improvements in decision quality, accountability, cross-functional alignment, and plan performance. 
 What You Bring to the Table: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Strategy, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience; master’s degree preferred. 
 10+ years of progressive experience across Supply Chain, Finance, Strategy, Commercial Planning, Operations, or related CPG functions, with meaningful leadership of IBP, S&OP, enterprise planning, or comparable cross-functional processes. 
 Demonstrated ability to mature an established IBP or S&OP process in a CPG, food, manufacturing, or similarly complex operating environment, including governance, facilitation, scenario planning, and change leadership. 
 Deep understanding of the distinct roles and interfaces among Demand Planning, Supply Chain Planning, Finance, AOP, S&OE, and IBP. 
 Experience with planning horizons that bridge near-term execution and longer-range strategic choices, ideally 18–36 months. 
 Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to connect operating assumptions and decisions to growth, margin, cash, service, capacity, inventory, and risk. 
 A facilitator-coach approach, with exceptional facilitation and communication across functions and leadership levels; able to simplify complexity and enable business-owned recommendations and decisions. 
 Strong analytical and systems thinking, paired with the willingness to work in the details when needed. 
 Experience with planning technology, scenario modeling, data visualization, and business intelligence; experience partnering on AI-enabled planning is helpful. 
 Adept at influencing without direct authority and building accountability across senior, cross-functional stakeholders. 
 This position is remote within the United States, with an estimated travel requirement of 10–20% based on business needs. 
 You’re no hero – You know the power of teamwork and celebrate the work of others before your own. 
 You give a sh*t – You believe in acting like an owner and making Vital Farms a place to be proud of. 
 You raise the standards – You know growth can be hard, but you strive to improve yourself and others each day. 
 You can walk in someone else’s boots – You seek to understand other’s viewpoints and think that you get to better answers by sitting on the same side of the table. 
 You do n’t w al k on eggshells – You’re not af raid to leave the bullsh *t behind and have honest conversations. 
 We recognize that talent comes in many forms. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may have strengths we haven’t yet considered! 
 What We Bring to the Table: 
 A fast-paced, energetic, remote environment with passionate people who are leading a movement to bring ethically produced food to the table.
 Competitive pay and benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, and Paid Parental Leave, just to name a few).
 Generous retirement contributions: 401(k) + 3% Contribution from Day 1.
 Free eggs , along with friends and family discounts. 
 Fun team SWAG that will make you the talk of the town.
 Professional development opportunities and an amazing team dedicated to your growth.

internalOnly.title: Director, Logistics
internalOnly.description:
**Internal Job Posting** 
This posting is intended for current Vital Farms employees. If you are not an employee, please visit our careers page to view available opportunities and follow the appropriate application process. 
 Finding the right place to grow your career isn’t (over) easy, so we’re here to help by sharing a few reasons why the grass is greener at Vital Farms. We think you’ll appreciate our focus on Conscious Capitalism, which drives business decisions that benefit all our stakeholders (leading to even better business results). You might be drawn to our innovative approach and refusal to settle for the “way things have always been done.” Or you could find it exciting to grow your skills while working for an industry-leading brand. Whether you’re into our values, our brand, or our egg- cellent puns, we hope you ’ll join our Crew and help us change the world 108 square feet at a time! 
 At Vital Farms, we’re proud of the diverse communities we serve and the stakeholders who help bring our purpose to life. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative environment where every crew member feels valued. We see this as one of our greatest strengths - and your role is key to helping us build on it. 
 Your Role: 
 This position reports to the Vice President, Supply Chain.
 You know that great logistics is more than moving product from one place to another. It is how we protect quality, deliver for our customers, support our farmers and crew, and grow responsibly. You bring a strong mix of strategy and operational leadership, and you are just as comfortable setting the direction for the network as you are working through a transportation disruption, a provider performance issue, or a difficult cost and service trade-off.
 At Vital Farms, you will lead our end-to-end logistics network across inbound farm transportation, outbound customer transportation, warehousing, cold storage, and distribution. You will build the systems, partner relationships, operating rhythms, and team capabilities needed to deliver reliable service, preserve cold-chain integrity, manage cost, and scale with the business.
 What You'll Do: 
 You will own the logistics strategy and lead the team and external partners responsible for moving and storing finished goods safely, reliably, and efficiently across the Vital Farms network.
 Lead the logistics strategy and network 
 Set and execute a logistics strategy that supports Vital Farms’ growth, customer commitments, stakeholder model, and evolving supply chain operating model.
 Own short- and long-range capacity planning across transportation, cold storage, warehousing, and distribution; identify constraints early and build practical contingency plans.
 Evaluate network design, lane strategy, storage footprint, and operating models to improve service, resilience, scalability, and total delivered cost.
 Translate logistics performance, risks, trade-offs, and required decisions into clear recommendations for Supply Chain and company leadership.
 Own inbound and outbound transportation performance 
 Oversee inbound transportation from farms and suppliers and outbound transportation to customers and distribution points.
 Lead governance for dedicated fleet and managed transportation partners, including routing, appointment scheduling, load building and optimization, tendering, carrier performance, freight claims, and special requests.
 Use on-time pickup, on-time delivery, customer scorecards, freight performance, and exception data to set expectations, drive accountability, and improve service.
 Serve as the senior escalation point for transportation disruptions, balancing immediate recovery with root-cause correction and prevention.
 Lead warehousing, distribution, and 3PL partnerships 
 Maintain overall accountability for receiving, storage, inventory handling, order fulfillment, and shipping of finished goods across the network.
 Manage and strengthen relationships with third-party transportation, distribution, and warehousing providers through clear governance, contracts, performance reviews, KPIs, and corrective action plans.
 Partner with site, Quality, and distribution leaders to maintain food safety, cold-chain integrity, inventory accuracy, pallet and load quality, and consistent shipment standards.
 Support new facility and distribution-capability readiness, including operating requirements, systems integration, launch planning, and transition into sustainable operations.
 Build financial and operational discipline 
 Develop and own logistics budgets and forecasts, including transportation, warehousing, distribution, accessorial, claims, and related operating costs.
 Identify cost drivers and loss areas, build fact-based recommendations, and deliver sustainable savings without compromising food safety, quality, crew safety, or customer service.
 Establish a practical KPI and operating-review cadence that creates one shared view of service, inventory flow, capacity, cost, risks, and actions.
 Partner with Finance and Supply Chain peers on forecasts, accruals, variance reviews, customer pickup economics, and business cases for logistics investments.
 Advance systems, data, and continuous improvement 
 Improve the integration and effective use of D365, transportation management systems, warehouse management systems, 3PL platforms, automation, and reporting tools.
 Connect operational data across internal and partner systems so teams can identify issues quickly and translate insights into action.
 Lead continuous improvement across transportation and distribution, including standard work, exception management, claims, inventory handoffs, customer feedback loops, and escalation paths.
 Partner with IT, Operations Development, and external providers to improve system reliability, visibility, controls, and readiness for future growth.
 Lead the team and cross-functional partnerships 
 Lead, coach, and develop the Logistics team with clear roles, priorities, decision rights, and accountability for results.
 Build strong working relationships across Farm Support, Operations, Supply Chain Planning, Customer Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, IT, and commercial teams.
 Create a culture of urgency, ownership, constructive challenge, learning, and recognition while modeling Vital Farms’ values.
 Build team capability and succession depth across transportation operations, analytics, systems, partner management, and network leadership.
 What You Bring to the Table: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
 You have 10+ years of progressive experience in logistics, transportation, warehousing, or distribution, preferably in food, beverage, CPG, or another temperature-sensitive environment.
 You have led a complex, multi-node logistics network and managed third-party transportation and warehousing providers.
 You understand transportation markets, carrier and fleet operations, warehousing and distribution, cold-chain requirements, and relevant regulatory considerations.
 You can manage budgets, analyze cost and service trade-offs, and deliver measurable operational and financial improvements.
 You have experience with ERP and supply chain execution technology, such as D365 or a comparable ERP, TMS, WMS, warehouse automation, and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
 You use data and sound judgment to turn operational details and ambiguity into clear decisions and action plans.
 You communicate clearly, influence across functions, negotiate effectively, and lead through external partners as well as direct teams.
 You are a proven people leader who coaches, develops talent, and creates clear accountability.
 You are available to travel approximately 20-30% based on business needs, provider reviews, facility support, and network initiatives.
 Bonus points if you have launched or scaled logistics capabilities, facilities, automation, or major system integrations.
 You’re no hero – You know the power of teamwork and celebrate the work of others before your own. 
 You give a sh*t – You believe in acting like an owner and making Vital Farms a place to be proud of. 
 You raise the standards – You know growth can be hard, but you strive to improve yourself and others each day. 
 You can walk in someone else’s boots – You seek to understand other’s viewpoints and think that you get to better answers by sitting on the same side of the table. 
 You do n’t w al k on eggshells – You’re not af raid to leave the bullsh *t behind and have honest conversations. 
 We recognize that talent comes in many forms. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may have strengths we haven’t yet considered! 
 What We Bring to the Table: 
 A fast-paced, energetic, remote environment with passionate people who are leading a movement to bring ethically produced food to the table.
 Competitive pay and benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, and Paid Parental Leave, just to name a few).
 Generous retirement contributions: 401(k) + 3% Contribution from Day 1.
 Free eggs , along with friends and family discounts. 
 Fun team SWAG that will make you the talk of the town.
 Professional development opportunities and an amazing team dedicated to your growth.

Job Title:
 Distribution Trainer ( Internal Only) 
 Department:
 Digital 
 Terms of employment:
 Contract, Hourly 
 Reports to:
 Han Tran, Room Manager 
 Rate:
 $23.40/hour 
 Location(s):
 70 The East Mall, Etobicoke, ON 
 Apply by:
 12:00 pm EST on Wed., November 18, 2026 
 The Role: Distribution Associate Trainer - Contract
 Availability: Full-time with an ability to work mornings, afternoons, and occasional overtime, holidays, and weekends.
 Reporting to Room Management, the Distribution Associate Trainer plays an essential role in developing talent within our business by collaborating and sharing best practices within their department. You help to quickly and efficiently promote the importance of quality for new hires in your room, all while making them feel welcome and supported. Through your hands-on approach to training, you support new hires to achieve their goals and targets and contribute to the success of the room. As a Distribution Trainer, you bring Lush’s Leadership Practices into all elements of your business: Be Real, Be Curious, Lead Fearlessly, Adapt and Evolve, Grow Talent, and Live with Purpose. 
 What do you do (Responsibilities) : 
 Formally welcome and orient new hires to your room, ensuring their comfort and familiarity with the space, the team, the brand, Health & Safety practices, and the product lines.
 Execute hands-on training with all new hires, ensuring their confidence, competence, and comfort with production. Follow in-room training and onboarding plans to ensure consistency, equity, and success for new hires.
 Introduce employees to quality standards and room expectations while creating a fail-safe environment for practice and learning during their onboarding period. Lead by example by demonstrating quality, cleanliness, and safety standards at all times.
 Motivate and engage new employees, encouraging and promoting their success through check-ins, in-the-moment support, hands-on collaboration, and sharing of best practices. Create an engaging work culture with a kind, welcoming, and supportive attitude and by setting clear expectations.
 Train on and support proper training methods as per the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

 Collaborate frequently with room leadership to support new hires and trainees, ensuring that everyone has the tools and resources needed to succeed. Also, ensure that any performance concerns are elevated early to support learners appropriately
 Perform Distribution Associate duties in the room as needed, including but not limited to:
 Assist in picking/packing high-quality Lush products
 Pick and pack products and correctly label packages
 Keep up with room demands and productivity targets
 Perform physically laborious tasks, including but not limited to: loading/pulling skids, pushing racks, carts/dollies , carrying bins of product

 Current Lush employee
 Excels in Distribution Associate duties

 Excellent coaching and feedback skills 
 Comfortable providing and receiving feedback
 Ability to multitask, meet deadlines, and manage priorities 
 Demonstrates curiosity with excellent listening and problem-solving skills 
 An accomplished trainer with a track record for supporting others to achieve success
 Demonstrated commitment to health and safety standards
 Demonstrated commitment to good manufacturing practices
 Able to do physical work for 8-hour shifts, on your feet, and lift 50 pounds
 Capable of physical activities such as standing for long durations, bending, pulling, and pushing
 Confident with basic mathematics; ability to count, including addition and subtraction
 Reliable, consistent attendance, punctual, and dependable
 Comfortable with reading, writing, and speaking English in order to communicate with colleagues on all platforms (i.e., in person, via email, via Google Chat)
 Preferred : 
 Experience as a Team Leader (seasonally) 
 Experience as a Distribution Trainer (seasonally) 
 Formal training or coaching experience

 Accustomed to meeting goals and deadlines in a seasonal and fast-paced environment
 Ability to navigate email and Google apps (i.e., Sheets, Docs, Chat, and Meet)
 Ability to work occasional overtime, weekends, and holidays based on the needs of the business

 Who Can Apply?

 What is a Joint Health and Safety Committee? 
 A Joint Health and Safety Committee (JHSC) is composed of worker and employer representatives. This co-operative involvement ensures that everything possible is done to identify and eliminate or mitigate workplace health and safety hazards. Together, they should be mutually committed to improving health and safety conditions in the workplace.
 Committees identify potential health and safety issues and bring them to the employer's attention and must be kept informed of health and safety developments in the workplace by the employer. As well, a designated worker member of the committee inspects the workplace at least once a month.
 What is the joint health and safety committee's role? 
 The committee is an advisory body that helps to stimulate or raise awareness of health and safety issues in the workplace, recognizes and identifies workplace risks and develops recommendations for the employer to address these risks. To achieve its goal, the committee holds regular meetings and conducts regular workplace inspections and makes written recommendations to the employer for the improvement of the health and safety of workers.
 What you do (Responsibilities): 
 Attend monthly JHSC meetings, other meetings and training sessions
 Conduct inspections of the workplace
 Encourage and support the Internal Responsibility System for effectively raising and resolving concerns, questions or issues
 Influence and support a positive health & safety culture
 Liaise with government officials such as Ministry of Labour (MOL) if required
 Assist employees with resolving issues
 Communicate back to the workers what you learned in the meetings
 Be available to other workers as someone they can speak to openly and confidentially
 When appropriate, share information and experience about health & safety issues with employees

 Current employee at 70 The East Mall in the Gifts department

 Familiar with Occupational Health and Safety legislation
 Experience in a leadership capacity

Nosso propósito é criar tecnologias que desafiam as melhores do mundo e mudam o jogo para nossos clientes. Por isso, buscamos profissionais que desejam fazer parte de uma cultura pautada pela excelência e inovação. Se você se identifica com um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e movido por curiosidade, venha construir o futuro da tecnologia conosco.
 Valorizamos o crescimento contínuo dos zuppers, incentivando cada pessoa a trilhar caminhos que impulsionem sua evolução profissional. 
 [Insira aqui um texto de explicação sobre o desafio da posição/projeto onde essa pessoa irá atuar]
 O que você fará por aqui 
 Definir a visão arquitetural de longo prazo e os padrões de engenharia de IA para produtos sistêmicos de alta criticidade.
 Evangelizar, desenhar e estruturar o ecossistema cross-teams de desenvolvimento nativo de IA (práticas escaláveis de SDD, Intent Development e Harness Engineering).
 Garantir a governança técnica e econômica de modelos de IA, gerenciando os trade-offs complexos entre custo de tokens, latência, segurança (guardrails corporativos) e privacidade de dados.
 O que esperamos que você saiba 
 Experiência comprovada com IA generativa e conhecimento profundo em LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, etc.) para desenvolvimento de assistentes virtuais e processamento de linguagem natural (NLP).
 Domínio em desenvolvimento backend avançado (Python ou ecossistemas similares), microsserviços, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e governança completa em ambientes cloud AWS (ECS, segurança e observabilidade).
 Construção e orquestração de agentes utilizando frameworks code-first (Deep Agents, LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Strands, CrewAI, Autogen ou similares) e workflows multi-step/multi-agent com function calling e saídas estruturadas.
 Vector databases e embeddings para manipulação eficiente de dados e representação semântica, além de familiaridade com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e suas variações (ex: GraphRAG).
 Engenharia de prompts e context engineering, além de benchmarking de modelos e estratégias avançadas de avaliação automática (monitoramento, precisão, groundedness).
 Desenvolvimento nativo de IA e Code Agents, sabendo interagir, guiar e auditar agentes autônomos de codificação.
 Práticas de SDD (Spec-Driven Development) e Intent Development, traduzindo intenções de negócio em contratos arquiteturais robustos para IA e minimizando a geração humana de código.
 Harness Engineering corporativo e esteiras de CI/CD para validação semântica contínua de agentes de codificação.
 Desenvolvimento e design de frameworks, bibliotecas ou plataformas internas de engenharia de IA para uso escalável por outros times de desenvolvimento.

Confirmada sua candidatura e analisado que seu perfil faz sentido para a posição escolhida, comunicaremos via e-mail a liderança e BP imediatos sobre sua aplicação em seleção interna.

public.title: Senior Procurement Specialist
public.description:
Overview 
KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end-to-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities. 
As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 57th largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2023 WA100 Survey. 
We invite you to join us. Why? 
When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company-wide health and well-being through on-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards, mentoring and coaching programs and extensive in-house on demand learning courses.  
Responsibilities 
We are eeking a highly experienced and results-driven Procurement Specialist with extensive experience in the construction sector, particularly in large-scale hospitality projects (hotels and mixed-use developments) at one of our mega projects in Almadinah, KSA 
Supervising the Project’s procurement and supply chain operations, ensuring cost efficiency, timely delivery, and compliance with project requirements while driving continuous improvement across the supply chain. 
Managing end-to-end procurement and supply chain operations, including sourcing, purchasing, logistics, warehousing, and inventory management. 
Demonstrating knowledge of high-end procurement materials associated with well-known hotel operators. 
Evaluating bids and making award recommendations to the Client. 
Ensuring bid compliance with local laws and regulations, including Local Content requirements. 
Supporting the Client in price negotiations during the award process. 
Preparing procurement plans for high-value projects. 
Developing and implementing procurement strategies, policies, and procedures to enhance operational efficiency and compliance. 
Managing supplier relationships, including vendor selection, evaluation, and performance management through KPIs and scorecards. 
Facilitating contract negotiations to secure favorable commercial terms and mitigate risks. 
Developing and managing departmental budgets, ensuring cost control and value optimization. 
Ensuring and tracking the timely availability of materials and services in line with project requirements (cost, quality, and schedule). 
Establishing and maintaining supplier databases and preferred vendor lists. 
Monitoring market trends, inflation, cost fluctuations, and supply risks to enable proactive procurement planning. 
Driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, efficiency, and cost savings. 
Collaborating with internal departments—including engineering, commercial, construction, and quality—to align procurement activities. 
Preparing and presenting procurement reports, forecasts, and variance analyses to the Client. 
Leading and developing procurement teams through training, performance management, and mentoring. 
Qualifications 
To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include a minimum of 15-20 years in procurement and supply chain within construction projects (preference for hotel projects). career experience partnered with a Bachelor degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related field. 
Hospitality and mixed-use building projects experience- Mandatory 
Professional certifications such as CPP, CPPM, CISCP, CISCM, or equivalent are highly desirable.

As a Key Holder, better known as a “Floor Leader,” at Skechers, you’ll take on an essential Retail Leadership Role, contributing to store operations and mentoring your team to deliver exceptional customer service. In this entry-level management role, you’ll oversee daily operations, support sales goals, and help maintain the store's premium shopping environment. Sales skills to drive revenue growth and meet targets.

public.title: Senior Lead, Customer Technology Advisor
public.description:
Who We Are 
At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role 
Your role
Join our dynamic team as a Customer Technology Advisor and become an integral part of our cutting-edge Go-To-Market team. As a certified expert in your field, you’ll be at the forefront of revolutionizing technology solutions for our valued customers, with AI at the core. Working hand in hand with our Kyndryl Consult Partners and customer partners, you will leverage your technical and solution expertise to drive targeted opportunities and exceed customer expectations.
In this role, you’ll be a trusted ally and visionary, delivering differentiated value to our customers. Through engaging demos and compelling presentations, you will showcase our credibility and authority in the industry, leaving a lasting impression on potential customers.
You have the unique opportunity to join us at a time when you can shape how our consulting practice operates today and evolves for the future.
What you will do
Lead and Coordinate
•Take the lead: Coordinate the entire pre-sales process, ensuring quality and compliance verification while adhering to Kyndryl best practices.
•Support the team: You’ll support Consulting, Advisory, and Architecture activities across Sales, Pre-Sales & Delivery, collaborating closely with Customer Partners and Kyndryl Consult Partners.
Develop and Deliver Solutions
•Think strategically: Identify the intricate business and technical requirements of our customers, leveraging our vast capabilities to generate winning cross-practice solutions.
•Drive our success: Use your extensive technical knowledge and mastery of the practice-specific domain, you’ll develop profitable deals.
Collaborate, Communicate and Build Relationships
•Collaborate to create: Your collaboration with internal and external stakeholders will generate winning responses and create optimal technical solutions.
•Connect our capabilities: Your exceptional customer facing skills, combined with your articulate communication style, will enable you to effortlessly convey the technical benefits of Kyndryl's capabilities, perfectly matching the unique needs of each customer.
•Create partnerships: You’ll actively build and nurture relationships with our external alliance partners, fostering a collaborative environment where joint solutions are co-created.
Demonstrate and Drive Value
•Show and tell: Your ability to develop and deliver compelling demonstrations, proof of concepts, and prototypes will clearly demonstrate the tangible value our offerings bring to our customers, leaving them eager to partner with us.
Showcase Expertise
•Spotlight your skills: Your technical prowess, backed by your external certifications, will establish you as a true authority in your field.
•Prove your acumen: Your dedication to continuous improvement and your passion for our practice will shine through as you showcase your end-to-end knowledge of the domain you align with, as well as the associated subdomains.
Who You Are 
Required skills and experience
•Deep domain knowledge of services offerings and technical solutions in a practice
•Demonstrated experience translating distinctive technical knowledge into actionable
customer insights and solutions
•Prior consultative selling experience
•Externally recognized as an expert in the technology and/or solutioning areas, including
technical certifications supporting subdomain focus area(s) including:
-Application Data and AI
-Cloud
-Core Enterprise and zCloud
-Digital Workplace
-Network and Edge
-Security and Resiliency
Preferred skills and experience
•Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree
•Experience selling technical services for multi-industry customers
Salary: $107,400 - $193,080 
The above represents Kyndryl’s pay range for this role. 
Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role.  The range provided reflects the target compensation range for the position at the time of posting.  Kyndryl’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. 
Being You 
The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect 
Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. 
Get Referred! 
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This position reports to: 
Operations Manager 
__
The work model for the role is: Onsite, Richmond, Virginia 
Your role and responsibilities: 
The Integrated Production Unit Leader (IPU) ensures efficient and cost-effective production results that meet order demand, specifications, quality, and planning targets through the coordination and management of plant equipment, personnel, and production processes (quantity, quality, budgeted costs, and proper productivity level). The role encompasses planning and fulfillment, assembly, packaging and test for both in-house production and contract manufacturing.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead a team within a Production unit or line to execute production processes, transforming parts and raw materials into ABB products in a timely and cost-effective manner. Each day, you will ensure continuous and efficient operation in accordance with volumes, schedules, procedures, drawings, and quality and safety standards and policies. You will also showcase your expertise by organizing and allocating resources to meet line production targets effectively and efficiently.
You will be mainly accountable for:
Ensuring that production scheduling and production plan meet the volume requirements agreed upon in the demand plan and defined inventory service levels; Driving strong Health and Safety Culture.
Recommending technical equipment and facility improvements as necessary; Identifying deficiencies in production area, proposing improvement activities, and overseeing implementation of actions to improve production performance.
Managing the resolution of critical product or equipment issues together with relevant internal teams; Owning material fulfillment activities.
Providing support to the Sales team, as required, during customer visits to explain the capabilities of the manufacturing facilities; Collaborating with Operational Excellence teams to integrate lean manufacturing principles into production processes.
Qualifications for the role: 
Bachelor degree in Engineering or Supply Chain or related field PLUS minimum 8 years experience in manufacturing and production
Demonstrated leadership of production teams and fulfillment teams.
SAP experience required 
Manufacturing experience localizing new products
Candidates must already have a work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

public.title: CRM Manager - Member Engagement (Germany)
public.description:
A BOUT TIDE 
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts: 
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 
As a CRM Manager, you’ll play an important role in delivering Tide’s CRM strategy in Germany, helping shape how we engage with our SME audience from onboarding through to retention. You’ll work within our established UK/Europe Lifecycle team to deliver relevant, timely communications that keep members engaged with Tide’s range of products and services.
We’re looking for someone who is data-literate, organised and hands-on, with experience planning, building and optimising CRM programmes across the member lifecycle. You’ll be comfortable working with stakeholders across the business and using campaign performance and customer insights to make recommendations and improve results.
You’ll be equally happy developing campaign plans, building journeys and automations, analysing performance, and working with stakeholders to turn insights into action.
AS A CRM MANAGER YOU’LL BE 
- Managing and delivering CRM activity for the German member lifecycle within the wider UK/Europe Lifecycle team, contributing to objectives and KPIs across:
- Activating new members onto the Tide platform
- Engaging existing members with Tide’s products and services
- Reactivating lapsing members
- Building new automated and standalone campaigns and optimising existing journeys to drive relevant next best actions for new and existing members
- Creating and QAing German communications, working with both German and English copy
- Supporting a CRM test-and-learn programme across multiple channels, including in-app, push notification, email and SMS, from ideation and execution through to analysis and optimisation
- Analysing campaigns and journeys, identifying trends and opportunities, and sharing performance insights and recommendations with stakeholders
- Building and maintaining reporting and dashboards to monitor CRM performance and identify areas for improvement
- Working with stakeholders across Product, Marketing and other teams to support product adoption, cross-selling and upselling through lifecycle communications
- Working closely with the Member Accession Marketing team (MAM) to create a consistent journey from lead through to membership and onboarding
- Supporting the development and implementation of CRM initiatives, taking ownership of delivery while collaborating with senior team members on strategy and priorities
- Sharing campaign results, learnings and recommendations and using these to continuously improve CRM activity
WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT 
- You have 3–5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle or retention marketing, ideally with hands-on campaign delivery experience
- You have experience working in a subscription, app-based, fintech or digital business; experience in the German payments or fintech sectors would be a plus
- You have a good understanding of the German market and customer landscape; knowledge of the German banking sector is desirable
- You have experience delivering CRM campaigns and programmes against clear objectives and KPIs
- You have strong stakeholder management skills and are comfortable working with both technical and non-technical teams
- You have hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as Iterable, HubSpot, Braze or Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC); SFMC experience would be particularly desirable
- You have an understanding of HTML and CSS and are comfortable working with CRM templates and communications
- You are confident working with data and BI tools such as Looker or Tableau, and can turn campaign performance data into actionable insights
- You have experience with segmentation, targeting and personalisation
- You have experience planning and executing tests across CRM channels and using results to optimise future activity

Review and analyze submissions including applications, policy wording, loss runs, inspection reports, and financial data to assess risk and determine appropriate underwriting decisions. Underwrite new and renewal business within your authority, ensuring profitability and adherence to the company's risk appetite. Develop and maintain outstanding broker and insured relationships within your territory, proactively identifying and generating new business opportunities. Communicate underwriting appetite clearly and effectively, promoting our value proposition to brokers and clients. Support cross-selling initiatives across AXA XL lines, collaborating with colleagues to maximize coverage solutions. Participate in business planning, forecasting, and monitoring of financial exposure, ensuring portfolio health and growth targets are met. Stay informed of industry trends, emerging risks, and market developments to provide innovative and practical risk management solutions. Travel approximately 20% for client and broker meetings, industry events, and team collaboration. You will report to the Underwriting Manager, Excess Casualty East Zone. What you’ll be doing We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience. Moderate Excess Casualty underwriting experience, with a robust understanding of general liability classes and risk assessment. Proven ability to manage a high-volume portfolio, with a focus on profitability and growth. Existing broker relationships within your territory are preferred, along with a demonstrated ability to build new relationships. Outstanding analytical, negotiation, and communication skills, with a client-centric approach. Self-motivated, organized, and able to work without supervision while collaborating effectively within a team. Knowledge of industry standards, market practices, and regulatory requirements. Who WE are AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it. How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty. With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward. Learn more at axaxl.com. What we OFFER Inclusion AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential. It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed. Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe. Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter Learn more at Inclusion & Diversity at AXA XL | AXA XL. Total Rewards AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides enterprising compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do. We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence. Sustainability At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations. Our Pillars: Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. public.title: OB Technician
public.description:
POSITION SUMMARY: 
The OB Technician, under the supervision of an RN or designee, performs basic care activities and administrative support for the Labor and Delivery department. OB Technicians will manage patient scheduling and charts. 
Reports to: OB Director
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: 
Performs basic patient care activities as delegated and supervised by an RN, including but not limited to monitoring vital signs, taking blood glucose measurements, and recording intake and output.
Monitors, records, and communicates patient condition as appropriate to care team, physician, patient, and family.
Assists patients with performing activities of daily living, including but not limited to bathing, grooming, nutrition, and ambulation.
Reports patient care needs accurately and concisely to the appropriate care team member.
Orients patient and family to room, call bell and unit while creating a therapeutic relationship.
Maintains confidentiality regarding patient and employee information.
Assists with the admission, transfer and discharge of patients as appropriate including transporting of patients throughout the hospital.
Completes hourly rounding. Participate in bedside shift report and shift huddles.
Assists in quality checks as designated (i.e. equipment temperature checks).
Promotes the bonding process of the mother/baby and family unit.
Supports the completion of the birth certificate process including collecting data from patients/family and sending to Health Information Management to meet required unit needs.
Assists with keeping patient rooms and common area stocked, clean and orderly.
Manages inventory and ordering for department. Checks supplied and inventory for expiration dates, weekly or as needed.
Acts as an extra set of hands for the surgeon and first assistants for Cesarean sections:
• Hands out sterile instruments and supplies.
• Prepares surgical equipment, holds organs in place, or holds retractors, for caesarean section.
• Arranges equipment and assists in surgical operations.
• Helps prepare the operating room and the patient for a surgical procedure.
• Sets up the sterile back table with instruments needed for the operation and drapes the patient and surrounding areas with a sterile barrier before the procedure begins.
• Assesses, plans, implements and evaluates surgical field according to standards of care, policies and procedures, utilizing interpersonal, critical thinking and technical skills.
• Performs instrumentation, equipment set-up, and medication preparation according to established policy and procedures.
Performs other job duties as assigned.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES: The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required.
Education: 
High school diploma or equivalent required.
Successful completion of nurse aide training program required with current State of Michigan Nursing Assistant certification required at hire or within 4 months of hire. Or graduate of Nursing School and Current Michigan LPN License required. Or successful completion of Medical Assistant program required with current CMA certification required.
Experience: Previous experience as a OB technician, surgical technologist or procedure assistant preferred
Licenses: 
Certifications: Basic Life Support (BLS) required. NRP essentials certification required within 3 months of hire required. 
Skills and Abilities: 
• Requires critical thinking skills, decisive judgment and the ability to work with minimal supervision. Must be able to work in a stressful environment and take appropriate action.
• Demonstrates proficiency in verbal and written communication skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to interact effectively and professionally with individuals at all levels; both internal and external
• Must be willing to learn on the job for technical skills.
PHYSICAL AND MENTAL DEMANDS: 
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job responsibilities.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit for extended periods of time; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, bend, crouch or crawl; talk or hear; taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. Repetitive motion of upper body required for extended use of computer. Required specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
WORK ENVIRONMENT AND TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS: 
Work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job responsibilities.
Works in well-lit, ventilated and climate controlled office environment with routine office equipment; some equipment has moving mechanical parts.
In hospital environment, may be exposed to hazards and unusual elements, which may include but are not limited to bloodborne pathogens and / or contagious illnesses, toxic chemicals, and biohazardous materials which may require extensive safety precautions and the use of protective equipment.
Noise level in the work environment is typical for an office and/or hospital environment.

Job Description: 
INFORMATION SECURITY ANALYST SR PRINCIPAL 
Advance your career while impacting our national security in cyber as an Information Security Analyst Sr Principal at GDIT. Here, technologists have many paths to grow a meaningful career supporting cyber missions and operations across the federal government.
MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT
As an Information Security Analyst Sr Principal, the work you do at GDIT will directly support the mission of our federal customer. You will play a critical role in achieving and sustaining the Authorization to Operate (ATO) for enterprise systems within a federal government agency. This position places you at the intersection of cloud technologies and Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC), contributing to an innovative and high‑visibility program.
We are seeking a candidate willing to join our Assessment & Authorization (A&A) team across all phases of the NIST Risk Management Framework, including:
• Categorizing information and system components
• Conducting Privacy Impact Assessments
• Developing risk management strategies
• Creating and maintaining security documentation
• Developing Security Control Implementation Statements
• Developing, tracking, and following up on Plans of Action and Milestones (POAM)
• Gathering information essential for drafting security controls, policies, and process documentation
You will develop Security Impact Analyses (SIA) for system changes and update key security documentation, including the System Security Plan (SSP), Information Security Contingency Plan, and other required security artifacts. You will coordinate with Federal Government officials to obtain and maintain the system’s Authorization to Operate (ATO).
You will ensure compliance with federal regulations and privacy requirements. Responsibilities include conducting investigations of information system security violations and incidents, security vulnerabilities, and reporting findings to management as necessary. You will also perform periodic and ad‑hoc system audits and vulnerability assessments including reviews of system scans, audit log reviews, user accounts, application access, file system integrity, and compliance‑related configurations.
Additionally, you will need to have experience with governance risk and compliance (GRC) tools such as JCAM/Archangel/Xacta. You will also participate in the Change Management process, collaborate with cross‑functional teams, customers and stakeholders on various projects as needed to ensure IT systems remain compliant with security requirements.
WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your cyber expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT. The Information Security Analyst Sr Principal must have:
● Education: Technical Training, Certification(s) or Degree
● Experience: 8+ years of related experience
● Technical skills: Information System Security, IT Risk Management, Cyber Security, Compliance, Change Management, Security Control Statements, Security Documentation, JCAM/Archangel/Xacta
● Security clearance level: Active Secret, Top Secret Preferred 
● US citizenship required

At VISITS, you’ll support a diverse range of clients, engage with the latest technologies and grow your skills and career, working with a team that values collaboration, growth and delivering meaningful outcomes - not just closing tickets.

public.description:
At Cleveland Clinic Health System, we believe in a better future for healthcare. And each of us is responsible for honoring our commitment to excellence, pushing the boundaries and transforming the patient experience, every day.
We all have the power to help, heal and change lives — beginning with our own. That’s the power of the Cleveland Clinic Health System team, and The Power of Every One. 
Job Title
Registered Respiratory Therapist 
Location
Cleveland 
Facility
Lutheran Hospital 
Department
Respiratory Therapy-Lutheran Hospital 
Job Code
D23042 
Shift
Evenings 
Schedule
10:30am-11:00pm 
Job Summary
Job Details
A caregiver in this position works evenings from 10:30 p.m. – 11:00 a.m. or 2:30 p.m. – 11:00 p.m. with weekend and holiday rotation requirements. 
Join Cleveland Clinic and experience world-class healthcare at its best. Cleveland Clinic Lutheran Hospital is a proud Magnet Hospital awarded by the American Nurses Credentialing Center, the highest honor an organization can receive for professional nursing practice. On our team, you will provide stellar patient care, receive endless support and appreciation, and build a meaningful career at one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world.
Respiratory therapists partner closely with nurses, physicians, and specialists to make a real impact every day while practicing at the top of your license. In this role, you will assess and treat patients with respiratory conditions, perform advanced cardiopulmonary evaluations, deliver lifesaving therapies, manage ventilators and airways, and respond to critical situations. This position provides the opportunity to learn from world renowned leading experts in respiratory care and offers a high level of autonomy in patient care and clinical decision making. You will be part of an innovative team that is shaping the future of respiratory care while playing a key role in patient education and care coordination.
How you’ll benefit:
Opportunities to participate in research studies
Tuition reimbursement for eligible educational programs
Reimbursement for credentialing and certification exam fees for new grads
Comprehensive professional development support, including funding for some courses and certifications
Individualized onboarding and orientation based on caregiver readiness, including a 3-week preceptorship and ongoing learning support
Flexible self-scheduling options, including the opportunity to self-select schedules at select locations
Diverse career advancement pathways, including Leadership, Education, Clinical Excellence, and Research
A caregiver who excels in this role will:  
Perform cardiopulmonary assessment to evaluate respiratory status.
Perform physical exams to assess breath sounds, work of breathing, and airway patency.
Review records, reports, and results such as radiologic tests, blood gases, hemodynamic monitoring, and pulmonary function tests.
Collaborate closely with physicians, nurses, and interdisciplinary team members to optimize patient outcomes and ensure continuity of care.
Administer medical gases (oxygen, nitric oxide), aerosolized medications, bronchial hygiene, and lung re-inflation techniques.
Follow established protocols, procedures, and practices for therapeutic procedures.
Perform blood gas sampling, puncture and analysis, arterial line insertion, pulse oximetry, and bedside pulmonary function testing and tracheostomy tube changes as directed.
Manage invasive and non-invasive mechanical ventilators and artificial airways.
Assist with bronchoscopy procedures.
Respond to medical emergencies, participate in trauma and resuscitation procedures, and assist with patient transport.
Assess for age-appropriate educational needs and provide patient and family education about the illness and care plan and provide information about community support groups and other programs. 
Serve as a preceptor for new employees and students enrolled in an accredited Respiratory Care program.
Record the care and treatment provided following established procedures.

Graduate of an accredited Respiratory Therapy program
