public.title: Advanced Systems Engineer - Aircraft Data Networks
public.description:
Advanced Systems Engineer – Aircraft Data Networks 
Join the Team Behind Honeywell Aerospace Anthem 
Honeywell Aerospace Anthem is an industry-leading, cloud-connected Integrated Flight Deck designed to bring greater connectivity, flexibility, and simplicity to modern aviation.
Built on a scalable software platform with cloud-native communications, navigation, and surveillance capabilities, Anthem supports a wide range of aircraft, from business aviation and commercial transport to defense platforms, general aviation, and emerging Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) vehicles.
Anthem is introducing a new level of cockpit personalization, allowing pilots to configure their flight deck based on mission needs and phase of flight while maintaining the reliability and precision the aerospace industry demands. By combining advanced connectivity, intuitive user experiences, and highly integrated avionics systems, Anthem is helping redefine how pilots interact with aircraft.
As an Advanced Systems Engineer - Next-Generation Aircraft Data Network, you'll play a key role in developing the network architecture that enables communication across the Anthem ecosystem. You'll work alongside a multidisciplinary team of systems, software, and avionics engineers to deliver resilient, high-performance solutions for one of the industry's most advanced flight deck platforms.
You will report to the Senior Software Engineering Manager and is based at our Deer Valley facility in Phoenix, Arizona.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
Drive the design, development, systems integration and verification of the Aircraft Data Network. 
Perform systems engineering activities including requirements analysis, system architecture development, integration testing, and validation of avionics systems operating within the Data Network
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, develop, and ensure seamless integration of Avionics software solutions that meet system requirements and performance specifications.
Stay current with industry trends and technological advancements in the Avionics space
YOU MUST HAVE 
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as the sciences, technology, engineering or mathematics. 
Minimum of four years of systems engineering experience including system design, architecture, integration, implementation, and troubleshooting.
Experience using engineering tools and technologies relevant to systems development.
WE VALUE 
Engineering degree from an accredited institution. 
Experience with avionics systems, integrated flight decks, or complex embedded systems in an AS6802 or similar Data Network 
Experience leading or contributing to complex system integration programs.
Software development experience.
Knowledge of industry best practices and emerging technologies to ensure compliance with industry standards.
Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Passion for innovation and continuous learning.
Experience with regulatory and certification compliance (e.g., DO-178, DO-254, ARP4754)
U.S. PERSON REQUIREMENT 
Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.​
We are currently not sponsoring applicants for work visas for this job. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.
BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL AEROSPACE  
Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
Short-term and long-term disability coverage
401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
Employee assistance program and educational assistance
Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time
Explore your benefits:  https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/ 
ABOUT HONEYWELL AEROSPACE 
Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution. 
Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.
Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.
THE BUSINESS UNIT 
The Next Generation Avionics (NGA) group at Honeywell Aerospace is dedicated to developing cutting-edge avionics systems that provide the necessary information for safe and efficient flights. From small aircraft to critical military applications, our comprehensive avionics systems are designed to meet the needs of the aerospace industry. Join our team and be part of shaping the future of avionics technology
Electronic Solutions:
Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.  
As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses:  https://www.honeywellaerospace.com  
Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology that help aircraft perform safely and with precision. Our systems are on board 90% of the world's aircraft — serving commercial aviation, defense and space operators from integrated flight deck platforms with 30-plus years in service to radiation-hardened systems trusted for human spaceflight.

public.title: Import-Export Compliance Specialist
public.description:
Zorg jij ervoor dat onze wereldwijde goederenstromen compliant, efficiënt en probleemloos verlopen? 
Ben jij een ervaren professional op het gebied van import, export en douanezaken? Krijg jij energie van complexe internationale logistieke processen en weet jij regelgeving moeiteloos te vertalen naar de dagelijkse praktijk? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!
Als Import-Export Compliance Specialist speel je een cruciale rol in het waarborgen van de internationale goederenstroom binnen onze organisatie. Je bent dé specialist op het gebied van douane- en exportregelgeving en zorgt ervoor dat zendingen wereldwijd compliant, tijdig en correct worden verwerkt. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van onder andere Warehouse, Customer Service, Operations, Trade Compliance en externe logistieke partners.
Wat ga je doen? 
Geen dag is hetzelfde. Je combineert operationele werkzaamheden met specialistische compliance-verantwoordelijkheden en bent een belangrijke vraagbaak binnen de organisatie.
Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden 
Coördineren en beheren van internationale import- en exportzendingen
Opstellen, controleren en opvolgen van import-, export- en douanedocumentatie
Bewaken van correcte toepassing van HS-codes, oorsprongsdocumenten, ECCN-classificaties en exportcontrolevereisten
Uitvoeren van controles op import- en exportaangiften
Onderhouden van masterdata, waaronder leveranciersverklaringen en oorsprongsinformatie
Signaleren van risico's en afwijkingen binnen exportcontroles en escaleren waar nodig
Ondersteunen bij de implementatie van nieuwe wet- en regelgeving op het gebied van Trade Compliance
Fungeren als aanspreekpunt voor collega's, expediteurs, douaneautoriteiten en externe partners
Ondersteunen bij audits en compliance-onderzoeken
Initiëren en deelnemen aan verbeterprojecten binnen logistieke en compliance processen
Begeleiden en trainen van nieuwe collega's tot Compliance Coördinator-niveau en hoger
Wat maakt deze functie interessant? 
In deze rol krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om impact te maken. Je werkt op het snijvlak van logistiek, douanezaken en compliance en bent betrokken bij zowel dagelijkse operaties als strategische verbeteringen.
Je bent bovendien een belangrijke sparringpartner voor management, operations en Trade Compliance en krijgt de kans om collega's te coachen en processen verder te professionaliseren.
Wie ben jij? 
Je bent een ervaren specialist die het overzicht bewaart, zelfs wanneer deadlines elkaar snel opvolgen. Je houdt van structuur, werkt nauwkeurig en weet complexe vraagstukken praktisch op te lossen.

Een MBO+ opleiding in Logistiek, Supply Chain of Douanezaken
Bij voorkeur een opleiding tot Douane Declarant
Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen import/export en internationale logistiek
Kennis van douanewetgeving, exportcontrole en trade compliance
Ervaring met ERP-systemen zoals SAP, Oracle of JDE
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal
Kennis van een extra Europese taal is een pré
Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende competenties
Proactief en zelfstandig
Sterke teamspeler
Klant- en servicegericht
Nauwkeurig en detailgericht
Analytisch sterk
Oplossingsgericht
Flexibel in een dynamische omgeving
Communicatief sterk op alle niveaus
Hands-on mentaliteit
Wat bieden wij jou?
Een uitdagende internationale functie binnen een toonaangevende organisatie
Veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief
Samenwerking met diverse interne en externe stakeholders wereldwijd
Mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen Trade Compliance en Supply Chain
Een professionele werkomgeving waarin veiligheid, integriteit en samenwerking centraal staan
Marktconforme arbeidsvoorwaarden en uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden
Klaar om impact te maken?
Wil jij jouw expertise inzetten om internationale handelsstromen compliant en efficiënt te laten verlopen? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog en word onderdeel van ons team.

public.title: Meewerkend Teamleider Flex
public.description:
Sliedrecht | 36 uur per week | €3.362-€4.799 | cao Gehandicaptenzorg 
“Boven de operatie staan, met je voeten erin.” 
Dinsdagmiddag. Je zit net in de KPI’s voor het komende kwartaal als een collega van Matchmaking binnenloopt: een zorgorganisatie heeft met spoed drie professionals nodig voor een project dat volgende week start, en de eerste ronde door het netwerk levert niemand op. Je schuift je laptop opzij, denkt vijf minuten mee, en samen hebben jullie een route. Daarna pak je die KPI’s weer op.
Sturen en meewerken. Voor jou is dat geen tegenstelling, maar hetzelfde werk.
Je geeft leiding aan Matchmaking en Planning & Support, de twee teams achter een netwerk van zo’n 500 zelfstandig zorgondernemers.
Wat ga je doen? 
Matchmaking brengt zorgvraag en aanbod bij elkaar, verzorgt de onboarding van nieuwe zorgondernemers en bouwt aan de kwaliteit van ons netwerk. Support zorgt dat alle dossiers volledig zijn en blijven, draait de planning van opdrachten en projecten en beheert de facturatie. Twee teams met heel verschillend werk, en jij houdt ze in balans.
Het werk is zelden standaard: veel maatwerk, veel verschillende opdrachtgevers, continu schakelen. Daarom hebben je collega’s iemand nodig die elk proces kent, boven de drukte kan staan en richting geeft als het schuurt. Jij bent hun klankbord bij ingewikkelde casuïstiek, en op piekmomenten draai je gewoon mee.
Daarnaast kijk je verder dan vandaag. Samen met de directie en het MT vertaal je de doelstellingen uit het meerjarenplan naar concrete KPI’s voor je teams, en je stuurt daarop. Je werkt mee aan onze specialistische zorgprojecten, waarin jouw teams een belangrijke rol spelen, en je zet marktontwikkelingen en commerciële kansen om in actie.
En dan het fundament eronder:
Je houdt regie over de bedrijfsprocessen in beide teams en bewaakt dat de werkprocedures consequent worden toegepast.
Je borgt het matchen van zorgondernemers op passende periodeopdrachten en bouwt mee aan duurzame relaties, aan beide kanten van de match.
Je houdt de kennis van je teams actueel rond flexwerk, zzp-bemiddeling en in- en doorleen, want die spelregels veranderen.
Je begeleidt samen met de opleidingsfunctionaris de ontwikkeltrajecten van je collega’s.
Wie ben jij? 
Jij verliest het overzicht niet als het druk wordt, en je kunt boven de operatie staan zonder de details uit het oog te verliezen. Je wacht niet tot een proces vastloopt: je ziet het aankomen en doet er iets aan.
Je stuurt met tact. Je durft richting te geven zonder de menselijke maat te verliezen, en je ziet het als jouw werk om iemand van medior naar senior te brengen. Dat je een zorgorganisatie onder druk anders benadert dan een zorgondernemer die vraagt of hij een dienst kan ruilen, doe je zonder erover na te denken.
Verder vragen we:
Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, of mbo 4 met hbo werk- en denkniveau.
Minimaal drie jaar leidinggevende ervaring.
Kennis van flexbemiddeling, zzp-dienstverlening of de zorgsector is een sterke pré.
Herken je je in dit profiel, maar niet op elk punt? Reageer gerust.
Eerlijk is eerlijk 
Deze functie past minder goed bij je als je vooral op afstand wilt managen en de operatie liever niet induikt, of als je een strak afgebakend takenpakket zoekt. Daarvoor is het werk te divers en gebeurt er te veel tegelijk.
Past dat juist wel bij je? Dan merk je hier binnen een maand wat jouw sturing oplevert.
Wat bieden wij jou? 
36 uur per week, met Sliedrecht als werklocatie.
Een salaris tussen €3.362 en €4.799 bruto per maand op fulltimebasis, conform FWG 55 van de cao Gehandicaptenzorg.
Je start met een tijdelijk contract. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan is een vast dienstverband de logische volgende stap.
8% vakantiegeld, een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%, 144 vakantie-uren en 57 balansuren op fulltimebasis, en pensioenopbouw bij PFZW.
Je mag je twee teams inrichten en processen verbeteren waar jij ziet dat het beter kan.
Ruimte om je teams en jezelf te ontwikkelen, met een vast ontwikkelkader en een opleidingsfunctionaris.
Collega’s die elkaar opvangen, en een organisatie waar een goed idee niet door vier lagen hoeft.
Daarom Zeno. 
Zeno brengt zorgorganisaties en zelfstandige zorgprofessionals samen. Die zelfstandigen noemen wij zorgondernemers. We werken vooral in de intensieve gehandicaptenzorg en de ambulante begeleiding. Vanuit Sliedrecht zorgen we dat de juiste professional op de juiste plek staat.
Dat netwerk groeit nog steeds, en steeds meer zorgorganisaties weten ons te vinden. Geen opdracht is een kopie van de vorige, en dat is precies wat deze functie interessant maakt: jij stuurt de teams waar dat maatwerk elke dag wordt geleverd.
Interesse? 
Geen lange motivatiebrief nodig. Stuur je cv en vertel kort wat jij in je eerste maand zou willen weten voordat je iets verandert.
Vragen of eerst even sparren? Bel Harry via 0184 636 712
Ken je iemand voor wie deze rol geknipt is? Deel deze vacature gerust.

public.title: Senior Construction Manager, Data Center Facilities Development
public.description:
About the Role 
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is seeking a Senior Construction Manager to lead the site execution of mission-critical data center projects in Singapore.
This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end accountability for construction delivery across base building, civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, controls, security, and life-safety systems. You will act as a key on-site leader, coordinating across project management, design, procurement, commissioning, operations, colocation providers, contractors, and vendors to ensure projects are delivered safely, predictably, and to OCI standards.
You will be expected to exercise strong independent judgment, identify delivery risks early, challenge weak plans, and drive the decisions and corrective actions needed to protect schedule, quality, cost, and readiness milestones.
What You’ll Do 
Lead Construction Delivery 
Own day-to-day site execution for complex data center construction projects, including AI and high-density infrastructure.
Oversee base building, MEP systems, white space readiness, containment, enabling works, and associated construction interfaces.
Ensure construction is delivered in accordance with approved design intent, project standards, local requirements, and OCI expectations.
Maintain strong site presence and provide clear leadership across contractors, colocation providers, consultants, and delivery teams.
Drive Schedule and Readiness 
Manage construction milestones, short-interval plans, look-ahead schedules, dependencies, and recovery actions.
Identify constraints before they affect critical dates and drive timely resolution across responsible parties.
Coordinate readiness across construction, tenant fit-out, network deployment, testing, commissioning, and final handover.
Ensure space, power, cooling, cable routes, access windows, cleanliness, and other prerequisites are available when required.
Own Risk, Quality, and Safety 
Independently evaluate project risk, actual progress, and delivery plans, with clear assessment of potential business impact.
Lead QA/QC execution, including ITPs, inspections, NCRs, corrective actions, punch lists, progressive turnover, and closeout.
Drive compliance with safety requirements, local regulations, codes, project standards, and OCI policies.
Lead incident follow-up, audit actions, and corrective measures to improve future execution.
Manage Contractors and Commercial Performance 
Hold colocation providers, contractors, and vendors accountable for scope, schedule, quality, safety, and coordination.
Support contractor performance reviews and provide structured feedback to inform future sourcing and delivery decisions.
Contribute to commercial administration, including variations, claims, extension-of-time requests, progress validation, and supporting records.
Ensure changes are controlled, documented, and assessed for schedule, cost, quality, and operational impact.
Lead Stakeholder Coordination 
Run daily and weekly site cadence, contractor coordination meetings, progress reviews, and issue-resolution forums.
Provide concise, executive-ready reporting on schedule, risk, cost, quality, safety, actions, and decisions required.
Maintain clear action, issue, and risk registers and escalate blockers early with proposed options.
Partner closely with design, commissioning, operations, network, procurement, legal, finance, and project controls teams.
Improve Delivery Standards 
Capture lessons learned and translate them into stronger construction practices, standards, and controls.
Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, quality, repeatability, and readiness across future data center projects.
Mentor less experienced team members and contribute to a high-accountability, high-performance construction culture.
What You’ll Bring 
10+ years of experience delivering data center, colocation, mission-critical, or comparable technical construction projects.
Strong construction knowledge across civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, controls, and plumbing systems.
Proven experience managing projects from mobilization through construction, commissioning readiness, turnover, and handover.
Strong understanding of high-density data center environments and the interfaces between facility delivery, tenant fit-out, network deployment, and operations.
Demonstrated ability to manage contractors, colocation providers, consultants, and vendors in complex delivery environments.
Strong schedule, risk, quality, and problem-solving capability, with confidence operating under pressure and ambiguity.
Experience supporting change management, claims, variations, EOTs, cost tracking, and progress validation.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear executive updates and drive decisions across multiple stakeholder groups.
Familiarity with project and document management platforms such as Aconex, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, SharePoint, or similar.
Why OCI 
OCI is building infrastructure for some of the most demanding cloud and AI workloads in the industry.
In this role, you will have meaningful ownership of how critical data center capacity is delivered—from site execution through readiness and handover. Your work will directly influence safety, speed to capacity, reliability, and the quality of infrastructure supporting Oracle’s cloud growth in the region.
This is an opportunity to operate at significant scale, work alongside experienced infrastructure leaders, and help raise the standard for how mission-critical data centers are delivered.
If you are a construction leader who combines deep technical judgment with strong execution discipline and thrives in high-accountability environments, we’d like to hear from you. 
#LI-DNI

About the Role
We're looking for a detail-obsessed, solutions-oriented Junior Attorney or Paralegal to own the end-to-end sales contracting process, reporting to the VP of Legal & Compliance. This is a high-volume, high-visibility role at the intersection of Legal and Revenue/Go To Market functions — you'll be the person who keeps deals moving without sacrificing the terms that protect the company. You'll draft, redline, and negotiate a large volume of sales agreements against tight SLAs, working directly with Sales, Deal Desk, Rev Ops, and Finance to unblock contracts and get to “yes” on terms that work for everyone.
The ideal candidate combines a lawyer's precision with a dealmaker's pragmatism: someone who reads every clause twice, catches the inconsistency everyone else missed, and then finds the creative middle ground that gets a stuck contract signed.
What You'll Own
Contract Lifecycle Management 
Own full-cycle drafting, review, and negotiation of sales contracts — MSAs, SOWs, Order Forms, DPAs, BAAs, NDAs, and amendments — from initial draft through execution.
Manage a high-volume contract pipeline against defined SLAs, prioritizing and triaging based on deal urgency, size, and complexity.
Redline incoming customer paper against Boostlingo's playbook and fallback positions, flagging material deviations for escalation.
Negotiation & Problem-Solving 
Serve as the primary point of contact for Sales and customers on contract terms, driving negotiations to close.
Identify contractual blockers early and proactively propose alternative language or structures that satisfy both risk tolerance and commercial goals.
Know when to hold a position, when to compromise, and when to escalate — exercising sound judgment on what's truly non-negotiable versus what's flexible.
Process & Cross-Functional Coordination 
Maintain and continuously improve the contract playbook, templates, and fallback clause library.
Track contract status, turnaround times, and bottlenecks; report on volume and SLA performance to the VP of Legal & Compliance.
Partner with Deal Desk and Finance on pricing, billing terms, and revenue recognition implications of contract language.
Coordinate with Security and Compliance on data protection, BAA, and SOC 2 Type II-related terms for regulated customers, including healthcare and language access accounts.
Support contract lifecycle management (CLM) tooling and workflow improvements to increase throughput as deal volume scales with Boostlingo's AI-first growth.
Risk & Compliance 
Ensure contracts comply with company policy, applicable law, and industry-specific requirements, including HIPAA/BAA obligations for healthcare and language access customers.
Maintain organized, audit-ready contract records and metadata in support of Boostlingo's broader compliance program.
What You'll Bring
Minimum Qualifications 
J.D. or paralegal certification/degree, with 1–4 years of relevant contract drafting and negotiation experience (in-house, law firm commercial practice, or paralegal role supporting a commercial legal team).
Demonstrated experience managing a high volume of commercial contracts in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Extraordinary attention to detail — you catch what others miss, every time.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain legal terms in plain language to non-legal stakeholders.
A pragmatic, creative problem-solver who can find acceptable middle ground rather than getting stuck on positions.
Comfort operating with ambiguity and competing priorities, and confidence making judgment calls within delegated authority.
Proficiency with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and redlining in Word/Google Docs (track changes fluency is a must).
Preferred 
SaaS or technology industry experience, particularly subscription/usage-based commercial models.
Familiarity with data privacy and security terms (DPAs, BAAs, SOC 2-related provisions).
Experience supporting a Sales or Deal Desk function directly, with an understanding of sales cycle pressure and SLA-driven workflows.
Prior experience building or refining contract templates and playbooks.
What Success Looks Like
Contracts consistently turned around within SLA, with a shrinking backlog as volume grows.
Sales and Deal Desk trust you as a partner who removes friction, not a bottleneck.
A well-maintained playbook and fallback library that reduces escalations over time.
Legal risk is properly managed without becoming a blocker to revenue.
Why Boostlingo
Join a four-time Inc. Magazine Best Workplace at a pivotal moment in the company's AI-first transformation.
High-impact, high-visibility role with direct exposure to Legal, Sales, and Executive Leadership.
Backed by Mainsail Partners, with a fast-growing customer base across healthcare, government, and enterprise language access.
WHAT MAKES BOOSTLINGO A GREAT COMPANY ? 
A values and mission-based ethos that drives our Finance strategy
Fun, energetic environment with an incredible culture (just ask about our eNPS scores!)   
Hybrid/Remote working arrangements

Daily Pay available

Flexible Hours

With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food.

As a Kitchen Assistant at Sur La Table, you play a key role in inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. With a passion for cooking, hospitality, and teamwork, the Kitchen Assistant supports the chefs to ensure smooth class operations and a #bestincenter experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. You’ll help bring culinary dreams to life by supporting our chefs, engaging with guests, and ensuring a clean, well-organized kitchen environment.

Customer Experience & Brand Representation
·        Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty.

public.title: Registered Behavior Technician (RBT)
public.description:
Alpaca Health

Work Location: In Person



If you want work that challenges you, changes lives, and builds a real career, this is it. For many of our roles you don’t need your RBT certification to apply. What matters most is that you love working with kids, you’re dependable, and you’re ready to show up. Some roles do require an active certification, but if you’re not certified yet, we’ll help you find your path to getting there.

Alpaca Health is a multi-state network of independent ABA therapists, working in homes, schools, and daycares. We hire certified RBTs and motivated people ready to become one. Either way, you’ll work alongside a dedicated BCBA who mentors you from day one, not a manager, not a corporate supervisor.



Two ways to join

Already an RBT

 - Active RBT certification

 - Start working and earning right away

 - Work with clients in your region

 - A path toward BCBA if you want it

Not certified yet

 - A clear path to becoming an RBT, with a BCBA mentor from day one

 - Many practices in our network reimburse RBT training and pay you during hands-on learning, and we’ll help match you with the right fit

 - Support as you prepare for and sit for your certification exam



The job
You’ll work one-on-one with kids with autism in their homes, classrooms, and communities. Every day is different. You’ll follow a personalized plan from your BCBA, implement behavior strategies, collect data, and build the consistent relationships that help kids grow. Your BCBA is closely involved and reachable, so there’s no guessing and no flying solo.



What’s in it for you:

 - $20–$27/hour, based on experience and location

 - Direct mentorship from a dedicated BCBA, not managers or a corporate chain of command

 - Full-time or part-time (some flexibility across mornings, afternoons, and evenings is needed to meet client needs; not sure if a schedule fits? Just ask, we have many)

 - Career growth support, including a path toward BCBA certification

 - Depending on the practice: training reimbursement and paid hands-on learning for those earning their certification



You’re a good fit if you:

 - Genuinely enjoy working with children, especially kids who need extra patience and creativity

 - Have an active RBT certification, or the drive to earn one

 - Have reliable availability across mornings, afternoons, or evenings, since our clients count on consistency

 - Come from education, childcare, psychology, social work, or any role where you showed up for kids

 - Have reliable transportation to reach client homes and schools

 - Can keep up physically, getting on the floor, moving around, staying active (able to lift ~50 lbs)

 - Are at least 18, have a high school diploma or equivalent, and can pass a background check



Why Alpaca Health
We’re not a big clinic chain. We’re a network of independent therapists who chose this work because they believe in it, and we match every RBT with a BCBA who mentors, not manages. We match families with providers who have availability now, and we work where families actually are. If you want a career where you see the results of your work every single day, this is it.



Ready? Apply now.
Not sure if you qualify? Apply anyway and tell us about yourself. We’d rather talk to one more curious person than miss someone great.

public.title: HVACR - Service Proposal and Technical Support
public.description:
Il presente annuncio di lavoro è rivolto a tutte le candidate e tutti i candidati in possesso dei requisiti richiesti, senza alcuna discriminazione fondata su sesso, genere, orientamento sessuale, nazionalità o origine etnica, credo religioso, disabilità e/o ogni altra condizione personale o sociale. 
Obiettivo generale 
La risorsa supporta il team Sales Service HVACR nella preparazione di offerte (riparazioni, retrofit, ricambi, manutenzioni e Service Agreements/PSA) e fornisce supporto tecnico di primo livello ai clienti, contribuendo a velocizzare emissione offerte, migliorare qualità tecnica/finanziaria delle proposte e ridurre i tempi di risoluzione delle richieste.
Responsabilità principali 
Il ruolo si interfaccia ogni giorno con funzioni interne ed esterne per predisporre offerte complete, corrette e coerenti dal punto di vista tecnico.
Service Sales per la preparazione di offerte e rinnovi, con attenzione a margini, termini contrattuali e definizione dello scope.
Clienti per raccogliere esigenze, chiarire richieste e validare le informazioni necessarie all’offerta.
Fornitori per ottenere quotazioni, disponibilità e dati tecnici utili alla definizione della proposta.
Field Service per il confronto tecnico e il reperimento di documentazione, parti e informazioni necessarie a interventi e offerte.
Digital/Connected Services per verificare il contesto operativo, quando sono attivi servizi connessi.
Responsabilità principali 
1) Service Proposal (offerte e preventivazione) 
Raccoglie e verifica input tecnici/economici (dati impianto, serial number, configurazioni, condizioni operative, vincoli sito, accessi, safety).
Supporta la costruzione dell’offerta: definizione attività, materiali/ricambi, ore, logistica, subappalti, note tecniche e assunzioni (in/out of scope).
Contribuisce alla generazione e sottomissione di preventivi tramite gli strumenti aziendali (es. processi di quote submission con aspettative GM, dove applicabile).
Predispone parti di testo commerciale/tecnico per Service Agreements su chiller e heat pump (benefici: riduzione downtime, contenimento costi, rapidità di servizio, monitoraggio/manutenzione/ottimizzazione).
Gestisce aggiornamenti e tracciamento stato opportunità, assicurando completezza documentale e passaggi corretti verso i referenti interni.
2) Technical Support (L1 / back-office tecnico) 
Fornisce supporto tecnico di primo livello su richieste ricorrenti: identificazione documentazione PED/tecnica, thickness tables, materiali, manualistica, parti di ricambio, chiarimenti su scope interventi.
Interfaccia con funzioni interne/esterne (es. supporti tecnici EMEA, factory/plant, customer service) per reperire dati non disponibili localmente e consolidare una risposta utilizzabile in offerta o in esecuzione.
Supporta la lettura e l’interpretazione di documenti tecnici su chiller e sistemi frigoriferi (ciclo frigorifero, componenti, misure/diagnostica di base), con attenzione a sicurezza e procedure.
Quando previsto, indirizza e supporta l’uso di riferimenti/guide per servizi digitali/connected su Industrial Refrigeration & Heating (release notes, user guide, contatti di supporto).
3) Miglioramento continuo, qualità e conoscenza 
Contribuisce a standardizzare template di offerta, checklist e note tecniche ricorrenti per aumentare “first-time-right” e ridurre rework.
Supporta la raccolta e strutturazione di feedback tecnico (FAQ, casistiche, lesson learned) per rafforzare la knowledge base e la capacità del team di risposta.
Competenze tecniche (Hard skills) 
Fondamenti di HVACR: ciclo frigorifero, componenti (compressore, condensatore, evaporatore, valvola di espansione), linee e principali logiche di funzionamento, Industrial Refrigeration (impianti e componenti tipici; refrigeranti e logiche di impianto) e Heat Pumps (principi e applicazioni; differenze operative rispetto alla sola refrigerazione).
Capacità di leggere/interpretare documentazione tecnica e requisiti di sicurezza e conformità (lavori su apparecchiature da personale formato, compliance a normative e procedure).
Dimestichezza con strumenti digitali e documentazione strutturata (guide, release, cataloghi interni) per supportare il servizio.
Buona conoscenza dei principali strumenti Office.
Competenze trasversali (Soft skills) 
Approccio analitico e attenzione al dettaglio (numeri, coerenza scope–costi–assunzioni).
Capacità di comunicazione chiara (scritta e orale) con interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici.
Orientamento al cliente interno, gestione priorità e rispetto scadenze.
Team work e proattività nel reperire informazioni mancanti coinvolgendo i canali corretti.
Requisiti (titoli/esperienza)
Diploma tecnico (Perito termotecnico/elettrotecnico/meccanico) o Laurea breve in ambito ingegneristico (meccanica/energia/industriale) – o esperienza equivalente.
0–2 anni di esperienza (o stage) in contesti HVACR/assistenza tecnica/offertazione/ufficio tecnico.
Italiano fluente; inglese tecnico scritto e parlato (lettura documenti, scambi mail con hub/plant).
Indicatori di performance (KPI) – esempi misurabili 
Lead time emissione offerta (tempo richiesta → bozza → invio).
Qualità offerta: riduzione richieste di chiarimento/rework; completezza tecnica e documentale.
Accuratezza economica: scostamento consuntivo vs preventivo (dove tracciabile).
Supporto tecnico: tempo medio di risposta e tasso di risoluzione L1 (es. documentazione/parti/indicazioni tecniche).
Contributo a efficienza operativa (es. indicatori di riparazione/fatturazione come MTTR/DTI dove utilizzati a livello operations).
I nostri benefici 
In Johnson Controls troverete un ambiente aperto a nuove idee ed esperienze appaganti, con la possibilità di svolgere un lavoro coinvolgente che vi stimolerà ad ampliare le vostre competenze e a fare carriera. 
Offriamo :
La retribuzione base iniziale per questa posizione sarà compresa tra 33.300 € e 45.800 € all’anno. Il pacchetto finale sarà definito in 
base all'esperienza, alle competenze e alle qualifiche rilevanti per il ruolo. 
Il pacchetto complessivo potrà includere componenti variabili e ulteriori benefit aziendali, che saranno illustrati nel corso del processo di selezione.
Ci impegniamo a garantire pratiche retributive eque, imparziali e neutrali rispetto al genere.
Contratto collettivo applicato:  Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro Industria Metalmeccanica e della Installazione di Impianti. 
Orario Flessibile
Possibilità di agile working
Ticket Buoni Pasto da 10 Euro
Welfare aziendale
Chi siamo 
Johnson Controls è una società globale diversificata e multi-industriale leader del settore, che serve una vasta gamma di clienti in più di 150 paesi. I nostri 130.000 dipendenti creano edifici intelligenti, soluzioni energetiche efficienti, infrastrutture integrate e sistemi di trasporto di nuova generazione che insieme funzionano perfettamente per garantire la promessa delle città e comunità intelligenti. Il nostro impegno per la sostenibilità torna alle nostre radici nel 1885, con l'invenzione del primo termostato elettrico. Siamo impegnati ad aiutare i nostri clienti a vincere e creare maggior valore per tutti i nostri stakeholder, attraverso la focalizzazione strategica sui nostri edifici e le piattaforme di crescita energetica.
Verranno considerate solamente le candidature in linea con il profilo ricercato. L'azienda ringrazia fin d'ora le persone che risponderanno all'annuncio. Le ricerche sono rivolte ai candidati dell'uno e dell'altro sesso (L.903/77 e L.125/9).

public.title: Livreur
public.description:
Le livreur du service de livraison de Sherwin-Williams est responsable de livrer des produits aux clients des magasins Sherwin-Williams à l'aide des camions ou fourgonnettes de livraison de l'entreprise. Les livreurs s'assurent que les livraisons sont complètes, emballées correctement, et livrées au bon client de façon sécuritaire. Les livreurs sont responsables de la satisfaction de la clientèle et du transport des articles de façon sécuritaire et dans le respect des délais. 
Préparer les livraisons de manière à répondre efficacement aux exigences des clients.
Charger adéquatement les commandes des clients dans le camion.
S’assurer que tous les formulaires requis sont dûment remplis.
Charger, transporter et livrer les articles aux clients de façon sécuritaire et ponctuelle.
Veiller à l’entretien du véhicule de l’entreprise et informer le superviseur de tout besoin de réparation ou de service.
Offrir un excellent service à la clientèle, répondre aux questions et traiter les plaintes de manière professionnelle.
Respecter les itinéraires assignés et suivre les horaires prévus.
Se conformer aux lois en matière de transport et maintenir un dossier de conduite sécuritaire.
Préparer les rapports et autres documents liés aux livraisons.
Utiliser l’équipement et les machines tels que les voitures, camions, chariots élévateurs, etc.
Accomplir diverses tâches en magasin, incluant le travail en entrepôt, la préparation des commandes (teinture et mélange), ainsi que le service aux clients au comptoir.

Être âgé(e) d’au moins dix-huit (18) ans
Doit être légalement autorisé(e) à travailler dans le pays d’emploi
Détenir un permis de conduire valide et sans restriction
Être capable, avec ou sans accommodement raisonnable, de récupérer du matériel sur des tablettes ou des piles au sol, et de soulever et transporter jusqu’à 50 lb fréquemment, et jusqu’à 70 lb à l’occasion
Être en mesure de lire, écrire, comprendre et communiquer en français
Qualifications privilégiées : 
Détenir au minimum un diplôme d'études secondaires ou un certificat de formation générale des adultes (CAEC)
Posséder au moins une (1) année d’expérience dans un poste de livraison, de vente au détail ou de service à la clientèle
Avoir au moins une (1) année d’expérience dans l’utilisation d’équipement de manutention (par exemple : chariots élévateurs debout ou assis, transpalettes, diables, préparateurs de commandes, palonniers à vide, chariots pour barils, convoyeurs, etc.)
Avoir une expérience antérieure dans la vente de peinture et de produits connexes

Professionel manicure og pedicure.

Negleforlængelser, opfyldninger og overlays.
French manicure og baby boomer-design.

Rådgivning af kunder om neglebehandlinger og stilarter.
Fremragende kundeservice.
Høj standard for hygiejne og kvalitet.

En stilling i en moderne, nyetableret skønhedssalon i det centrale Aarhus.

Moderne udstyr og et bredt udvalg af negleprodukter og farver.
Et veletableret walk-in-koncept.
Intet ansvar for at skaffe kunder eller styre bookinger.

public.title: In Room Dining Server
public.description:
About Four Seasons: 
Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.           
At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.
About the location: 
On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.” 
Be You 
The In Room Dining Server will be in charge of providing food and beverage service to our guests and clients, guiding them in the concept of the outlet and products, always seeking complete satisfaction of the expectations of our guests and clients, creating epic experiences. 
Target Hire Date – October 2026 
Skills and Abilities:  
Minimum experience of 2 years in ultra-luxury hotels.
Knowledge of high service standards.
Strong knowledge of spirits, cocktails and wines.
Mastery in stressful situations and maintaining high-level service quality.
High ability to communicate with others.
Reading, writing and oral proficiency in both Spanish and English language          
Proactive.
Strong presentation skills.
Highly developed problem-solving skills.
Able to work effectively under pressure and with a high volume of business.
Able to multitask and prioritize workload and projects simultaneously and efficiently.
Schedule availability
*This position requires applicants to have valid work authorization in Mexico.  
Master Your Craft 
Comply with the standards of attending your work shift on time.
Complete assigned daily tasks.
Promotes teamwork by delegating and executing daily tasks.
You will attend and absorb the training done by FS.
Comply with annual training sent by learning.
Has knowledge of internal safety protocols in emergency situations.
Knows and executes the safety and hygiene guidelines within the service and work shift, motivating others to do so as well.
Has knowledge of and applies state liquor regulations, respecting the rules established for minors, intoxicated people, and driving while intoxicated.  
Have full knowledge of the F&B menus, ingredients, preparation methods, allergens, preparation times, etc.
Ensures the correct setup of the salon before, during and at the end service period, following established standards.
Learn and follow the service sequence established under the standards for FS.
Anticipate the needs of our guests and colleagues.
Give recognition to our guests and clients.
Make sure to do the corresponding charges on the bills presented to our clients.
What We Offer and What You Can Expect     
You will become part of a supportive team with a genuine family spirit, where your talent will be valued and recognized.    
Highly  competitive salaries , with an attractive annual incentive plan for management and Department Head positions.    
Transportation service  from  San Lucas and San José del Cabo to the resort.    
Uniform laundry service , ensuring comfort and a professional appearance.    
Training programs  and  in-house workshops to support your professional development.    
A dynamic, diverse, and challenging work environment with close interaction with the leadership team.    
Recognition   programs  that celebrate your achievements, including awards for years of service, Employee of the Month, and Employee of the Year.    
About Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:     
Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts opened its first hotel in 1961, and its history has been one of continuous innovation, remarkable growth, and an unwavering commitment to the highest standards. For nearly 50 years, Four Seasons has transformed the hospitality industry by combining genuine care and efficiency with the finest traditions of international hospitality.  Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts has been ranked EVERY YEAR as one of FORTUNE Magazine’s   “100 Best Companies to Work For ”  since 1998 and has been named a Great Place to Work Legend, an honor currently held by only 12 companies worldwide.     
Service Culture     
Currently operating 120 hotels and resorts and 45 residential properties in major city centers and resort destinations across 47 countries, with more than 50 projects under planning or development, Four Seasons consistently ranks among the world’s finest hotels and most prestigious brands in reader surveys, traveler reviews, and industry awards. Our greatest asset—and the key to our success—is our people. We believe that each of us deserves a sense of dignity, pride, and satisfaction in what we do.   
What Is It Like to Work for Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts?     
At Four Seasons, we guide all our actions by the Golden Rule: “Treat others as you would like to be treated.” Here, you will work on a team built on mutual respect, collaboration, exceptional service, and a passion for hospitality. As a luxury brand, your work will also be guided by the highest standards to ensure exceptional quality and service at all times. Expect to work hard while having fun and learning along the way, taking your career, experience, and skills to the next level. As an added benefit, working with Four Seasons gives you the opportunity to build an international career and travel around the world while staying at incredible properties at no cost.

public.title: Project Manager III
public.description:
As a Project Manager III, you will manage and oversee all aspects of a project to ensure it is completed on-time and within budget. public.title: General Manager (Sur La Table)
public.description:
With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. 


Position Overview
As a General Managerat Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the store by leading high-performing retail and culinary teams that inspires customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience.  This position combines strategic business acumen with strong operational expertise to drive both culinary and retail business performance while delivering #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service.  
 
Key Responsibilities
Leadership & Team Development
·        Recruit, develop and retain a high-performing team to meet the business needs of both culinary and retail.
·        Lead, coach, and inspire associates to exceed performance expectations and uphold a positive team culture.
·        Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide feedback, and create development plans to support individual and team growth. 
Customer Experience & Brand Representation
·        Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty.
·        Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources.
·        Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture.
·        Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely manner to maintain satisfaction and loyalty.
Sales & Business Performance
·        Develop and implement strategies, including effective merchandising, marketing, and customer engagement, to exceed sales and financial goals across culinary and retail operations.
·        Monitor and analyze key performance metrics daily to identify opportunities and optimize store performance.
·        Consistently meet or exceed culinary and retail goals by delivering exceptional classes and customer experiences that drive engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail product sales, individual sales volume, average transaction value, customer conversion rates, and guest feedback through Google reviews.
Operations & Compliance
·        Oversee daily store operations, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures.
·        Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and ensure proper product merchandising.
·        Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly.
·        Maintains the accuracy and integrity of associates’ records, including but not limited to time and attendance data, food safety certifications, and personal information. 
·        Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws.  Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. 
·        Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed.
 
Physical Requirements
·        Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers.
·        Ability to remain standing for up to 5 hours at a time.
·        Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor.
·        Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor.
·        Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs.
·        Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise.
·        Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work.
·        Workweeks are expected to be between 46 and 48 hours with the ability to have a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
·        Regular and predictable attendance.
 
Qualifications & Experience
·        Must be 21 years of age or older at the time of employment.
·        3+ years of retail management experience, preferably in a specialty or culinary retail environment.
·        Current Food Manager Certification, or ability to acquire certification as needed
·        Proven track record of achieving sales and motivating high performing sales teams while meeting operational goals.
·        Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, develop, and retain a high performing team.
·        Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
·        Passion for community engagement and providing exceptional customer experiences.
·        Proficiency in Microsoft Office and retail management systems preferred.

public.title: Occupational Therapist (OT) – ACCESS Early Childhood
public.description:
Description
Some of the most meaningful moments in occupational therapy happen through small accomplishments that make an extraordinary difference in a young child’s life. A toddler learning to grasp a spoon and feed themselves independently. A preschooler developing the coordination and confidence to participate in play alongside friends. A child learning to navigate sensory experiences that once made everyday activities overwhelming. 
At ACCESS Early Childhood, those moments are what our work is all about. 
We're looking for an Occupational Therapist who loves working with young children, sees the possibilities in every child, and wants to be part of a team that shows up for one another as much as they do for the children and families they serve. 
Our therapists work alongside early childhood educators, evaluators, and other clinical professionals in a collaborative environment where expertise is valued, ideas are shared, and everyone works toward a common goal: helping young children build the foundational skills they need to learn, play, grow, and thrive. 
A rewarding career with room for life outside of work 
We know that meaningful progress doesn't happen by accident. It takes skilled therapists, the right resources, and a team that supports one another. We also believe the professionals doing this important work deserve time for their own lives.
At ACCESS, you'll enjoy:
15.5 paid holidays and 18 days of paid time off annually — a total of 33.5 paid days off
No nights or weekends, with steady, predictable daytime schedules
Competitive salaries with opportunities for milestone bonuses
Paid professional licensure and continuing education (CEUs)
Medical, dental, vision, and short-term disability coverage
401(k) with employer matching opportunities
State-of-the-art therapy facilities designed specifically for pediatric care
A collaborative environment where therapists, educators, and other professionals work together toward each child’s goals
Opportunities to pursue professional interests through special projects and programs
A family-friendly workplace that recognizes the importance of life beyond work
Requirements
What we're looking for 
A degree in Occupational Therapy from an accredited college or university
Current Arkansas licensure as an Occupational Therapist
Strong communication, organizational, and clinical documentation skills
A genuine interest in working with infants, toddlers, and preschool-aged children 
A collaborative, child- and family-centered approach to clinical care
Find your place at ACCESS 
The most rewarding work happens when talented people have the resources, encouragement, and support to do what they do best.
At ACCESS Early Childhood, you'll find a team that shares your commitment to young children, celebrates the milestones that shape early development, and understands that supporting therapists is an important part of helping students succeed.
If you're ready for a new opportunity where your work matters and your life outside of work matters, too, we'd love to meet you.

public.title: Regional Key Account Manager – Spare Parts
public.description:
About us
At Dyson, we solve the problems others choose to ignore, with surprising new inventions that defy convention and simply work better. Our Customer team shapes extraordinary experiences for Dyson owners worldwide. We deliver proactive, fast, and thoughtful support that makes customers feel valued. We build loyalty through meaningful engagement, inspire advocacy, and turn every interaction into long‑term connection. Guided by our principles - effortless experiences, global consistency, personalisation, and relentless improvement - we ensure every customer’s journey with Dyson is exceptional.
About the role
As  Regional Account Manager – Spare Parts  at Dyson, you’ll own some of our most critical partnerships for our Spares & Accessories (S&A) business. Your focus: building, managing, and accelerating strategic relationships with our key global & regional distribution partners. You’ll align internal cross-functional teams to deliver best-in-class execution on spare parts listings, availability, merchandising, promotions, and commercial agreements—ensuring sales targets and high customer satisfaction are met and exceeded. 
Key Responsibilities  
Account Ownership:  Act as the global & regional lead for assigned key accounts—setting clear joint business plans, targets, and strategies for the spare parts category. 
Sales Growth:  Drive growth for spare parts in partnership with global distribution partners through powerful range management, sell-in, and sell-out initiatives.

RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available 
CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history. 
Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems has an opening for a Staff Nuclear Hardness & Survivability Systems Engineer to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. The position will be located in Melbourne, Florida. 
As part of the Nuclear Hardness and Survivability (NH&S) team, you will have a unique opportunity to support design and mitigation strategies to develop and field a survivable weapon system with operational requirements involving the following nuclear threat environments: Electromagnetic Pulse, Ionizing Radiation, Thermal Radiation, Air-Blast and Radiological exposure. 
In this role, will work throughout the Engineering & Manufacturing Development and Production & Deployment phases of the program providing expertise including the following: 
Generating weapon system design criteria supported by design analysis, modeling & simulation, equipment and system-level trade studies, system integration, piece-part, component, equipment, and system test artifacts. 
Developing system-level NH&S Design Analysis Reports (DAR) and nuclear hardness system test plans and reports documenting equipment compliance and weapon system certification. 
Preparing and presenting Nuclear Survivability engineering artifacts supporting requirements compliance and weapon system performance traceability throughout Design Reviews. 
Lead and execute the analysis and/or evaluation/validation of components, equipment, subsystems, or weapon system analytical models and actual system implementation for weapons compliance to operationally relevant nuclear threat environments. 
Domain Specific Responsibilities/Technical Skills 
Working knowledge of nuclear weapons effects and resulting Transient Radiation Effects on Electronics (TREE) of DoD and commercial systems. 
Technical planning, specification requirements derivation, test and analysis, design, planning and execution, documentation, and requirements/validation supporting overall system compliance. 
Experience with electrical circuit rad-hard design including piece-part screening, analysis, modeling, and test of component and systems for radiation environment compliance i.e. prompt dose rate, total ionizing dose, neutron displacement damage, neutron induced upset, single event effects. 
Experience with electrical circuit and/or system level design and test. 
Knowledge of Circumvention & Recovery techniques for component, circuit, equipment subsystems compliance and weapon system level probabilistic performance assessments during pre/trans and post nuclear weapon environment exposure. 
Evaluate uncertainty and risks associated with rad-hard requirements and design mitigation strategies. 
Experience working with other Federal agencies, industry, National and/or Service Laboratories & Test facilities. 
Represent Northrop Grumman Corporation as a technical expert for the Program and with US Government customers. 
Basic Qualifications 
Must have a Bachelors of Science degree in a STEM field and at least 12 years of relevant military / professional experience, OR a Master's Degree in a STEM field and at least 10 years of relevant military / professional experience, OR a PhD and at least 8 years of relevant military / professional experience
Must have an active US Government Secret or higher clearance (with a background investigation completed within the last 6 years or currently enrolled into Continuous Evaluation). 
Must have the ability to obtain or maintain an interim US Government Top Secret clearance or higher within a reasonable amount of time as determined by business needs.
Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) clearance within a reasonable amount of time as determined by business needs. 
Must have the ability to travel as at least 20% of your work responsibilities
Preferred Qualifications: 
Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with teams across geographically dispersed locations. 
Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communications skills to present data and recommendations to internal and external customers 
Nuclear Command, Control & Communication weapon system survivability design experience 
Analysis experience with radiation environments including man-made and natural space environment. 
Analysis experience in Reliability, Availability, Maintainability & Testability (RAMT) including probabilistic risk assessment as applicable to semiconductor TREE susceptibilities. 
Experience and/or familiarity with the following standards and handbooks DODI 3150.09 
MIL-STD-1766, AFWL-TR-86-26 
MIL-STD-464, MIL-STD-3023, MIL-STD-2169, DO-160, MIL-B-5087 
DNA-2048H-1 
MIL-STD-883, MIL-STD-750, JEDEC JESD89, MIL-HDBK-814, MIL-HDBK-815, MIL-HDBK-816, IEC 62396-1/-5, SAE AIR6219 
Experience and/or familiarity with the following engineering software/tools COMSOL, ANSYS, CST, FEKO 
Cadence/Spice 
Mathworks MATLAB, PTC MathCad, Wolfram Mathematica 
NX, Siemens Teamcenter, CAMEO

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.   

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.  

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The role

You will be BJAK's person on the ground, responsible for getting the business established and growing. That means building partner relationships from scratch, working out how the market operates, and shaping the strategy that sits behind both.

This is a broad role in a new market. Some weeks will be partnership negotiation, others will be regulatory groundwork, operational setup, or working out why something is not converting. We are looking for someone comfortable moving between all of it rather than a specialist in any one part.


What you will do

Partnerships

 - Identify, approach and close partnerships with financial institutions and ecosystem players

 - Own each relationship end to end, from first conversation through negotiation, onboarding, integration and go-live

 - Lead commercial negotiations, with sound judgement on pricing and partnership economics

 - Keep a visible pipeline, with disciplined follow-up and clear reporting

 - Work with legal, product, technology and compliance to get agreements live quickly

Get the market working

 - Establish how we operate locally, including the regulatory requirements that apply to us

 - Work with external counsel and internal compliance on the policies we need in place as we grow

 - Act as a primary point of contact for regulators and manage filings and communications

 - Own monthly revenue, volume and activation targets, and drive partner productivity after go-live

Strategy and operations

 - Set the local strategy — which segments we go after, which partners matter most, where we compete and where we do not

 - Build the operating rhythm behind it, from reporting and planning through to the processes the team runs on

 - Feed what you learn locally into our wider regional and global strategy, and bring the global playbook back into the local market

 - Work with teams across the group, taking what has already worked elsewhere rather than rebuilding from scratch


What we are looking for

 - Fluent Indonesian and English, written and spoken

 - Obtained WPE/WAPERD qualification

 - At least five years across technology, financial services or a comparable commercial environment, with real negotiation and partnership experience

 - A generalist who has operated across functions — you have done commercial work, but also picked up operations, regulatory, product or whatever else the situation needed

 - Comfortable moving between strategy and execution, and willing to do both in the same week

 - Evidence of building something from nothing, whether a market, a function or a business line

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and self-directed. We expect initiative rather than instruction, and this role will not suit someone who needs to be nudged or handheld

public.title: Foods Vietnam DT & RTM Lead
public.description:
Earlier this year, Unilever announced an agreement to combine its Foods business with McCormick & Company, creating a scaled global flavour powerhouse. The proposed combination would bring together iconic Foods brands, including Hellmann’s and Knorr, with McCormick’s portfolio to create a global leader across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by strong retail and foodservice platforms. McCormick brings more than 135 years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions, with completion estimated for mid-2027.  
JOB PURPOSE  
Lead nationwide Foods Distributor Trade business, from route-to-market strategy to execution, driving delivery of Primary Sales, Secondary Sales, coverage and distribution across all regions. Ensure execution excellence and business performance through the salesforce and distributor partners, delivering Foods priorities consistently and driving sustainable growth.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES    
Own route-to-market strategy and effectiveness: Define and continuously strengthen Foods DT route-to-market model, including coverage, distribution and service design, and determine the sizing, structure and deployment of the field force required to serve Foods effectively and efficiently across regions.  
Build the national Foods DT plan: Translate Foods business and channel priorities into a national DT delivery plan and cascade it into clear regional objectives and actions.  
Own sales delivery: Drive Primary Sales and Secondary Sales across all regions, run a disciplined performance rhythm to review results, identify performance gaps, and ensure timely recovery actions.  
Lead joint business planning with distributor partners: Align targets, priorities, execution commitments and performance expectations to drive secondary sales, coverage and execution.  
Drive national Foods DT performance: Take accountability for delivering Foods priorities across regions, partnering with the DT organization and cross-functional teams to drive portfolio, pricing, promotion, distribution and execution excellence. Maintain disciplined performance management and consistent execution standards to deliver sustainable sales and market share growth.  
Prioritize where to win: Direct focus, resources and trade investment towards the highest-impact opportunities, while identifying and capturing new sources of growth.  
Lead through change: Play a leading role in driving Foods DT agenda through a period of transition, helping shape and embed effective ways of working across teams and partners. Make decisions under ambiguity and sustain strong business performance as the operating model continues to evolve.  
Build a high-performance field culture: Establish strong execution standards and field discipline across the DT organization, and build a capable, high-performing field sales force with strong ownership and a winning mindset to continuously raise the quality of execution.  
EXPERIENCE & SKILLS    
Substantial Customer Development or commercial leadership experience in FMCG or a comparable consumer business, including ownership of complex business priorities and performance delivery.  
Strong analytical capability, with the ability to translate customer, channel and performance data into clear priorities and actions.  
Strong leadership, stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to mobilize teams and partners behind business priorities and drive delivery across complex environments.  
Sound planning, performance management and execution discipline, including prioritization, risk identification and timely course correction.  
Solid understanding of route-to-market design and DT operations, including coverage, distribution, field force deployment and the commercial levers (portfolio, pricing, promotion, execution) that drive sustainable sales and market share growth.  
Ability to lead through change, make timely decisions under ambiguity, and translate evolving priorities into effective action while maintaining strong business performance.  
MINDSET & BEHAVIOURS    
Act with integrity and sound judgment, taking ownership of decisions and outcomes.  
Deliver performance with care, setting high standards while supporting others to succeed.  
Prioritize what matters most, simplify complexity and focus resources on the actions that create the greatest business impact.  
Think strategically, convert priorities into action and remain adaptable through change.  
WHAT SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE    
Foods business targets are consistently delivered across DT, with strong Primary Sales, Secondary Sales and market share performance.  
Coverage, portfolio distribution and execution standards are strong and consistent across regions, with an effective route-to-market and field force model driving sustainable growth and competitive advantage.  
Commercial resources and trade investment are focused on the highest-impact opportunities, maximizing business performance and returns.  
The DT organization operates with strong discipline, clear priorities, and effective ways of working, enabling consistent execution and long-term growth.  
Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. public.title: Founding Finance
public.description:
ABOUT TERAC

Terac is building the infrastructure for accessing human capability on demand. We are working toward a future where Terac deeply understands:

 1. What every person is capable of, what they want, and where they can thrive

 2. What work our customers need completed and what success requires

 3. What creates a great match between the two

With this understanding, Terac can intelligently allocate human capability to the work where it creates the most value for both our experts and customers. Today, our initial wedge is providing specialized experts for AI training, evaluation, market research, and other expert-driven research.

We place 1,000s of experts per month and pay our experts, on average, over $90/hr. We're a team of 15 based in San Francisco. We've raised $16M from SignalFire, Emergence, Audacious, and SV Angel, and we work with leading AI labs and research companies.


THE PROBLEMS WE GET TO SOLVE

Terac is a two-sided marketplace, and the most interesting problems live where the money moves.

 - Pricing work we've never seen before: every project is different (a cardiologist for a 30-minute interview, 200 Amharic transcribers, a team of licensed engineers building RL environments), and we have to quote it in hours, not weeks.

 - Setting the right pay for experts: rates vary by domain, country, and urgency. Pay too little and the best experts walk. Pay too much and the project stops working for the customer.

 - Managing spread and take rate: the gap between what customers pay and what experts earn funds everything we build, and it looks different across market research, AI training, and data collection.

 - Liquidity on both sides: the right experts available the moment a customer needs them, across thousands of niches, without burning out supply or overpromising to demand.

 - Moving money globally: we pay experts across dozens of countries every month, often before customers pay us, which creates real working capital, FX, and fraud challenges.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Terac is growing fast. We pay thousands of experts across dozens of countries every month, invoice a growing roster of enterprise customers, and are scaling revenue month over month. Today, finance is spread across the founders, our Chief of Staff, and outside providers.

You will be our first finance hire and own the function end to end, partnering directly with the CEO. This role owns the economics behind all of the above: pricing, pay rates, margins, and cash. You thrive in ambiguity, have exceptional judgment, and are equally comfortable building a board-ready model and reconciling a payout batch.


YOU WILL:

 - Own the numbers: monthly close, accounting, revenue recognition, and reporting, working with our outside accountants and auditors.

 - Run cash and payments: AR/AP, collections, and the global contributor payout engine that pays thousands of experts every month across many countries and payment rails.

 - Build planning and forecasting: budgets, burn, hiring plans, and the operating model, plus project-level margin analysis and pricing support for deals.

 - Support fundraising and the board: investor updates, data rooms, and diligence for future rounds.

 - Build the systems: choose and implement tooling (ERP, spend management, payroll, billing) and the controls that let us scale 10x.

 - Handle compliance: sales tax, 1099s and international contractor compliance, insurance, and corporate filings with our legal partners.


YOU HAVE:

 - 3-7+ years in finance or accounting, ideally a mix of Big 4, banking, or consulting and a high-growth startup

 - Hands-on experience owning close, cash management, and financial modeling

 - Comfort building systems from scratch and working with ambiguous, messy data

 - Strong judgment and the ability to prioritize under pressure


YOU LIKELY HAVE EXPERIENCE IN:

 - Finance at an early-stage or high-growth startup, often as the first or second finance hire

 - Marketplaces, payments, or businesses with high-volume global payouts


MISC

 - Compensation: Competitive salary, meaningful equity vested over four years, $10K relocation bonus (for moving to the Bay Area), and an additional $5k housing bonus (if you move within 0.5 miles of our office), Health, Dental, Vision insurance, 401(k) with company match

 - Growth opportunities: You're joining Terac at one of the earliest stages and will have an opportunity to shape and grow with the company as a founding member.
