public.title: Director of Sales, Union Labor and Trusts
public.description:
Virta Health is on a mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. Current treatment approaches aren’t working—over half of US adults have either type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, and obesity rates are at an all-time high. Virta is changing this by helping people reverse their metabolic condition through innovations in technology, personalized nutrition, and virtual care delivery reinvented from the ground up. We have raised over $350 million from top-tier investors, and partner with the largest health plans, employers, and government organizations to help their employees and members restore their health and take back their lives. Join us on our mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people.

As a Sales Director for Virta you will be responsible for selling to union, labor, and trust organizations with membership between 1,000-20,000 members. You will have the opportunity to help build our commercialization efforts and capitalize on the national attention Virta is receiving for our industry-changing work.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Pick up established prospect funnel and move prospective clients through to contracting phase and close

 - Leverage demand generation work from Marketing team to create new opportunities

 - Growth - Close new logos and expand existing relationships

 - Work with customer success and the health plan team for expansions leading to increased revenue for Virta.

 - Leverage and educate ASO partners and consultants for territory pull through

 - Further promote Virta as an innovative cardiometabolic reversal solution

 - Work closely with Vitra team members to provide client/prospect feedback


90 DAY PLAN

Within your first 90 days at Virta, we expect you will do the following:

 - Build internal relationships with Virta team members

 - Learn the Virta story and begin pitching to prospective clients and consultants

 - Begin outreach to prospects currently in the funnel

 - Partner with your SDR to create a territory plan

 - Create and begin executing business plan for success


MUST-HAVES

 - 7+ years selling an innovative healthcare solution to union, labor and trust organizations nationally

 - Consistent track record of achieving sales targets in this vertical

 - Establish and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders including union trustees, fund administrators, and consultants

 - Ability to represent Virta at union events, trustee summits, and industry events to build brand awareness and pipeline

 - Familiarity with union benefit structures, including governance processes

 - Quantifiable history of hitting personal sales targets

 - Ability to present clearly to key decision makers

 - Consultative selling experience from lead gen to contract signature

 - Ability to proactively manage pipeline

 - Demonstrated collaboration with internal colleagues (marketing, product, ops, etc.) to support sales momentum

 - A passion for improving the health of millions of people

 - The ability to thrive in a fast-growing startup environment

 - Demonstrates a proactive use of AI tools to improve individual output and efficiency. For more information about AI usage in our hiring process, see Virta's AI Interview Resources https://www.virtahealth.com/careers/ai-interview-resources page.

 - Bonus points for:
   
   - Existing relationships with key decision makers
   
   - Knowledge of cardiometabolic space and of potential competitors


VALUES-DRIVEN CULTURE

Virta’s company values drive our culture, so you’ll do well if:

 - You put people first and take care of yourself, your peers, and our patients equally

 - You have a strong sense of ownership and take initiative while empowering others to do the same

 - You prioritize positive impact over busy work

 - You have no ego and understand that everyone has something to bring to the table regardless of experience

 - You appreciate transparency and promote trust and empowerment through open access of information

 - You are evidence-based and prioritize data and science over seniority or dogma

 - You take risks and rapidly iterate

Is this role not quite what you're looking for? Join our Talent Community and follow us on Linkedin to stay connected!

Virta has a location based compensation structure. Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience. For this role, the compensation range is $141,000 - $182,000.  Information about Virta’s benefits is on our Careers page at: https://www.virtahealth.com/careers.

As part of your duties at Virta, you may come in contact with sensitive patient information that is governed by HIPAA. Throughout your career at Virta, you will be expected to follow Virta's security and privacy procedures to ensure our patients' information remains strictly confidential. Security and privacy training will be provided.

As a remote-first company, our team is spread across various locations with office hubs in Denver and San Francisco. 

Clinical roles: We currently do not hire in the following states: AK, HI, RI

Corporate roles: We currently do not hire in the following states: AK, DE, HI, ME, MS, OK, SD, VT.

Virta uses Ashby as its applicant tracking system, which incorporates AI-powered tools (provided by OpenAI, AWS, and Google Gemini) in certain aspects of the recruiting process, including application review, candidate screening, and interview note taking; your data is not used to train AI models, and all final hiring decisions are made by Virta Health personnel. For more information, see Virta’s AI Interview Resources page. https://www.virtahealth.com/careers/ai-interview-resources

public.description:
IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS: 
Upload Resume or Curriculum Vitae for automatic population of information to the application.
The contact information, work experience, and education listed on your Resume/CV will be parsed and input into your Montclair application.
Review information and double-check all fields containing information that the system parsed – the software is intelligent, but you need to verify that the data is accurate.
In the “My Experience” section, you will find a Resume/CV upload option where you can submit your cover letter and all other supporting documents.
Note: If you have an expansive CV, we recommend that you apply manually and only include the positions you have held in the last ten (10) years . You will then be able to attach your Resume/CV, as well as all other supporting documentation in the "My Experience" section of your application.
Job Description 
SUMMARY : 
Reporting to the Assistant Vice President of Budget and Planning, the Budget Analyst is responsible for assisting in the implementation of resource planning and allocation practice, and assisting with all aspects of the budgeting process and budget management.
PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES : 
Assist with the development and monitoring of the University's annual operating budget.
Prepare budgetary and demographic information for the annual budget submission to the State of New Jersey's Office of Management and Budget.
Serve as Budget Office liaison to specific units of the University as assigned, assisting those units with the management of their budgets.
Provide budget analyses and forecasts for presentation to the Board of Trustees.
Assist with development of personnel and fringe budgets.
Assist with long-range financial projections including, but not limited to, scheduled debt service, personnel expense, tuition and enrollment, and other items.
Use a variety of data systems and spreadsheets to analyze student enrollment, personnel headcount and other statistical data that impact financials.
Use the University's financial system to create or approve budget journals and transfers.
Assist with the development of budgeting and reporting software used by Budget & Planning.
Work with Finance & Treasury department on allocations, budget closing, and year-end transfers.
Uphold and support existing University policies and procedures and make recommendations that enhance its business practices.
Serve on ad hoc committees and task forces, etc., as assigned.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Management retains the right to add or change job duties at any time.
QUALIFICATIONS :
REQUIRED :  
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Accounting, Finance, Economics or related field.
Minimum three years of experience in a budget, finance, or related department.
Knowledge of budget and statistical analysis.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience with computer systems for finance and budgeting.
Ability to communicate financial concepts to a variety of employees in the University.
Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and learn new systems.
PREFERRED :
Master's degree in related field.
Experience working in a University or large non-profit setting.
Knowledge of Workday Financials.
PROCEDURE FOR CANDIDACY 
Applicants should include a resume and cover letter describing how their background, skills and education match the needs of the University. When applying, please take a moment to carefully read and follow the steps in the application instructions

public.description:
Are you passionate about leading a world-class sales team? 
Would you like to shape the future of Public Sector sales for the U.S and Canada? 
Join our growing Sales team! 
We empower the public sector with cutting-edge technologies that enable government agencies, defense organizations and public institutions to achieve their missions securely and efficiently. Our team is at the forefront of delivering reliable, scalable solutions for our nation's most critical missions.
Partner with the best 
You'll lead Public Sector sales strategy to drive revenue growth, expanding client relationships across Federal, SLED and Canadian government markets. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify new opportunities, optimize sales performance, and deliver high-impact results. Implementing innovative solutions tailored to market demands and fostering a culture of excellence and accountability across the sales organization.
As a Vice President for Public Sector, you will be responsible for:
Defining and implementing a multi-year GTM strategy to drive Public Sector growth, ensuring team accountability for quotas, pipeline, and forecasting.
Overseeing the dedicated Public Sector channel team, driving co-sell models with government aggregators (e.g., Carahsoft), federal VARs, and top GSIs.
Partnering closely with global engineering and product leadership to prioritize public-sector feature requirements, GovCloud roadmaps, and localized technical architecture.
Directing strategy for major government contract vehicles (GSA MAS, NASA) while ensuring sales alignment with federal compliance requirements (FedRAMP, IL4/5/6).
Recruiting, coaching, and retaining a high-performing organization of sales directors, field account executives, and channel managers across Federal and SLED verticals.
Serving as the executive sponsor on complex government procurements, building trusted relationships with senior agency stakeholders, SES personnel, and procurement officers.
Working closely with internal Divisions (Engineering, Products, Services, Marketing, InfoSec, Compliance) to define and execute the strategy for the Public Sector.
Do what you love 
To be successful in this role you will:
Have 15+ years of relevant SaaS/Cybersecurity sales experience and a Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology or its equivalent
Have experience managing public sector sales teams with target responsibilities exceeding $100M revenue and delivering double-digit digit annual growth.
Understand networks across Federal, SLED, and GSI leadership, with expert command of FAR/DFARS, contracting vehicles, and government security authorization frameworks.
Have a proven track record aligning technical engineering roadmaps, professional services delivery, and complex regulatory standards with revenue growth.
Be able to command the federal acquisition processes (FAR/DFARS), key contracting vehicles, and government security authorization standards (FedRAMP, FedRAMP High, StateRAMP).
Be a collaborative team player with the ability to manage, influence and achieve alignment across different interests.
Possess a growth mindset and situational adaptability to effectively lead an organization in a dynamic, changing environment.
Be a U.S. Citizen and have Secret or Top Secret Clearance
About us 
At Akamai, we're curious, innovative, collaborative and tenacious. We celebrate diversity of thought and we hold an unwavering belief that we can make a meaningful difference. Our teams use their global perspectives to put customers at the forefront of everything they do, so if you are people-centric, you'll thrive here.
At Akamai, we will provide you with opportunities to grow, flourish, and achieve great things. Our benefit options are designed to meet your individual needs for today and in the future. We provide benefits surrounding all aspects of your life:
Your health
Your finances
Your family
Your time at work
Your time pursuing other endeavors
Our benefit plan options are designed to meet your individual needs and budget, both today and in the future.
Work in a way that works for you 
FlexBase, Akamai's Global Flexible Working Program, is based on the principles that are helping us create the best workplace in the world. When our colleagues said that flexible working was important to them, we listened. We also know flexible working is important to many of the incredible people considering joining Akamai. FlexBase, gives 95% of employees the choice to work from their home, their office, or both (in the country advertised). This permanent workplace flexibility program is consistent and fair globally, to help us find incredible talent, virtually anywhere. We are happy to discuss working options for this role and encourage you to speak with your recruiter in more detail when you apply. 
Learn what makes Akamai a great place to work
Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like! 
Compensation 
Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For US based candidates only - The On Target Earnings (OTE, base salary + commissions) for this position ranges from $398,600 - $717,400/year a candidate’s OTE is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. Compensation for candidates outside the US will vary. The compensation package may also include equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). public.description:

About the Position 
Are you interested in playing a key role in the growth of the nation's fourth-largest county?
As the Plans Examiner, you will provide reviews of residential, commercial, and other construction plans to ensure completeness, accuracy, and conformance to applicable building codes, ordinances, national standards, and zoning regulations. In addition, you will perform a variety of duties involved in providing customer information and assistance related to the development process, including but not limited to planning, building, zoning, code enforcement, drainage review, and maintaining records using the County's automated permitting system and computerized geographic information system.
About Us 
Maricopa County is GROWING. At the Maricopa County Planning and Development Department, we want you to join us in making that growth possible! With our wide range of services, from land-use planning to building inspections and permit review, we have positions that allow professionals in the planning, construction, engineering, and trade fields to shape the future of the built environment. If you're interested in being a change-maker and behind-the-scenes expert in the growth of Maricopa County, we have the job for you!
Proud to Offer 
Work with a greater purpose
Tuition reimbursement
Exceptional work-life balance
Opportunities for growth and development within Maricopa County
Low-cost, high-value healthcare for you and your qualifying dependents
Child care benefits, including access to the Maricopa County Kids Club , dedicated to serving Maricopa County families
Paid vacation, sick time, and parental leave
Extensive wellness program, including an incentive
Enrollment in the Arizona State Retirement System, a defined retirement benefit requiring a 11.98% per paycheck contribution rate that includes a 100% employer match on Day 1
Want to learn more about the County’s Qualifying and Compensation Philosophy? Follow this link to learn more! Work With Us | Maricopa County, AZ 
We Require 
Three years of experience in architectural, residential, or commercial building plan review, which includes reading and interpreting commercial and residential construction plans and specifications
High school diploma or GED
Post-secondary education in Urban Planning, Urban Geography, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Public Administration, or a related field may substitute for the experience on a year-for-year basis
We Also Value 
Post-secondary education in Urban Planning, Urban Geography, Architecture, Engineering, Landscape Architecture, Public Administration, or a related field
Experience in conducting research, analyzing problems, and issues related to building construction and land-use controls 
Experience in customer service 
Building Plans Examiner or Building Inspector certification with any of the following organizations: International Code Council (ICC), International Association of Plumbing & Mechanical Officials (IAPMO), or the International Association of Electrical Inspectors (IAEI)
Mechanical, plumbing, and electrical plan review experience
Job Contributions 
Review residential and commercial building permit applications and civil/site plans to ensure compliance with adopted building codes and ordinances, state statutes, and federal/state regulations
Review aerial and floodplain maps to gather information to determine the level of additional review required for permit issuance
Initiate and notify the public of address changes
Function as a subject matter expert by displaying a thorough and deep understanding of the department's functions
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with the public, staff members, governmental agencies, contractors, and the public to explain and administer development requirements and codes, including but not limited to planning, building, zoning, code enforcement, and drainage review
Other duties as assigned
Working Conditions 
The work environment for this position will include working indoors and outdoors, on stairs and ladders, and in confined areas, both in a typical office setting and during site inspections. The physical environment will consist of sitting, standing, walking, driving, climbing, and crouching in a standard office setting, as well as site inspections. May have to carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds
Exerting up to 20 pounds occasionally, 10 pounds frequently, or negligible amounts constantly, or requires walking or standing to a significant degree
Position is typically office or administrative work and is not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions
Selection Procedure 
Consideration will only be given to candidates who submit online applications
Candidates will be contacted primarily through email and their Workday online application profile
Must pass a pre-employment background and/or fingerprint investigation as required by statute or policy, including drug and alcohol testing requirements for positions designated as safety-sensitive
Maricopa County is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process or to perform the essential functions of the position under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), please contact MHRFeedback@maricopa.gov to initiate the interactive process.

public.title: Executivo(a) de Contas Estratégicas III - (Farmer)
public.description:
Nosso modo de fazer no time 
 Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.
 Seu Cardápio Diário 
 Gestão Estratégica da Carteira (Foco Principal): Gerenciar e desenvolver uma carteira de contas estratégicas composta por grandes marcas e restaurantes parceiros nas cidades de atuação. O foco principal é a atuação consultiva, construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo e ganho de confiança dos stakeholders sêniores.
 Atendimento e Consultoria de Vendas: Realizar diagnósticos analíticos e consultivos para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e apresentar o ecossistema completo de produtos (tecnologia, financeiros, turbo, hits, totens, etc.).
 Análise Crítica e KPIs: Monitorar e analisar diariamente os principais indicadores de performance do negócio, tais como: pedidos, faturamento, conversão, cancelamentos, % de chamados, ROI e investimentos.
 Geração de Receita e Rentabilidade: Focar na rentabilização da carteira por meio da venda de múltiplos produtos/serviços (cross-sell e up-sell) e captação de alavancas de investimento/exclusividade, garantindo o crescimento do faturamento.
 Prospecção Oportunista (Perfil Secundário): Mapear e buscar novas oportunidades de negócios e parceiros estratégicos no mercado para complementar a gestão da carteira (Farmer/Grower), atuando de forma pontual conforme a orientação da liderança (posição com perfil majoritariamente consultivo, não sendo puramente Hunter).
 Rotina de Campo Disciplinada: Realizar visitas diárias e contínuas aos parceiros comerciais, mantendo uma rotina de campo intensa para garantir a proximidade e o resultado.
 Desenvolvimento de Mercado e Inteligência Competitiva: Monitorar tendências, concorrentes e movimentos do mercado local para adaptar estratégias comerciais e garantir a competitividade de preços e ofertas.
 Resolução de Conflitos Complexos: Atuar na condução de atritos, negociações complexas e resolução de problemas de forma consultiva com stakeholders sêniores dos parceiros.
 Ingredientes que buscamos 
 Foco em Resultado e Autonomia: Forte senso de Dono(a), disciplina para autogestão da agenda e foco na superação de metas e resultados.
 Negociação e Influência: Habilidade comprovada em negociações complexas com alto poder de influência e condução de conversas consultivas com stakeholders diversos.
 Resiliência e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de prosperar em ambientes de alta cobrança, ritmo acelerado e constante mudança, mantendo a inteligência emocional.
 Comunicação de Alto Nível: Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com clareza para apresentar diagnósticos e planos de ação.
 Domínio de IA e Tecnologia: Domínio e forte familiaridade prática com ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial (como Gemini, NotebookLM) e agentes de IA para otimização de processos comerciais, construção de prompts eficientes e tomada de decisão fundamentada em dados.
 Google Workspace: Domínio de planilhas eletrônicas (Google Sheets, Apresentações, Formulários, Drive) para o acompanhamento e consolidação de KPIs de negócio.
 Sobre nós 
 No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e atingir #Resultados incríveis, por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde pessoas escolham como lugar para se desenvolver e contribuir para a realização de sonhos, #AllTogether.
 Conheça nossas iniciativas → 
 Você tem fome de que? 
 Nós, FoodLovers, temos fome de inovação e resultado. Buscamos sempre fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e atuando com agilidade e responsabilidade! Temos fome de diversidade, conhecimento e compartilhamento. Trabalhamos em um ambiente de muita versatilidade. Sabe o que promove a nossa receita especial? As pessoas! Vem fazer parte disso🤝

HOU Real Estate (E&I) Associate Attorney
public.description:
The Role 
Clifford Chance is seeking a Real Estate Associate with at least four years of experience to join its Real Estate practice, with a particular focus on supporting the continued growth of the firm’s Energy & Infrastructure practice.
The associate will advise on sophisticated real estate matters arising in connection with energy and infrastructure development, acquisition and financing transactions. Responsibilities will include drafting and negotiating purchase and sale agreements, leases, easements, option agreements, access agreements and other site-control documentation; conducting and managing title, survey and other real estate due diligence; and identifying and resolving real estate issues affecting project development and financing. The associate will work closely with clients, counterparties, title companies, surveyors, consultants and attorneys across practice areas, while also gaining exposure to broader commercial real estate transactions, including acquisitions, dispositions, joint ventures, development projects and financings.
Your experience 
Experience with real estate matters relating to energy, renewable energy or infrastructure projects strongly preferred.
Experience with title and survey review, site control, acquisitions, dispositions, leasing, easements and related real estate documentation.
Experience supporting financing transactions from a real estate perspective is particularly valuable.
Strong drafting, negotiation, analytical and project-management skills.
Ability to work effectively across practice areas and manage multiple complex transactions simultaneously.
Excellent academic credentials and strong written and verbal communication skills.
Admission to the Texas bar is required. Submissions must include a resume and law school transcript(s).
Clifford Chance US LLP offers a comprehensive benefits and compensation package. Subject to the candidate's experience, the salary range for this role is $310,000 - $390,000. Actual salary will be commensurate with the candidate's qualifications and relevant experience.
Equal Opportunities 
At Clifford Chance, we forge an inclusive culture, where all perspectives are recognised and valued. It’s a culture where everyone has equal access to opportunities to thrive and succeed, irrespective of background. We are guided by our values-based Code, which sets high standards of conduct and has a principle focused on being inclusive.
We are an equal opportunity employer and provide consideration to all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We comply with the law and regulations in every location where we operate and across all aspects of employment, from recruitment and selection to development, progression, and day-to-day working life.  
Find out more about our inclusive culture  here

public.title: Account Executive
public.description:
About Jim Peplinski Capital 
Jim Peplinski Capital (JPC) has been financing vehicles and equipment for Canadian businesses for more than 35 years. We are growing, and we are looking for a Account Executive who wants to build their own book of business and get paid for what they create.
We combine capital, fleet expertise and technology to help businesses make better decisions about their vehicles and equipment.
The Role 
This is a new-business, outside sales role. You’ll own the sales cycle from the first cold call through to the signed customer and handoff to onboarding.
You’ll be prospecting, asking for referrals, meeting customers and creating your own opportunities. You’ll spend your time with owners, CFOs and senior decision-makers, earning their trust, understanding their businesses and building solutions around what they actually need.
What You’ll Do 
Prospect, generate referrals and create new business opportunities.
Get in front of owners, CFOs and other senior decision-makers.
Understand each prospect’s business, fleet, financial requirements and growth plans.
Identify opportunities to lower costs, reduce complexity and improve how customers finance and manage their vehicles and equipment.
Build financing and fleet solutions around the customer’s business, not a template.
Present recommendations, negotiate terms and close new business.
Work with Credit, Customer Service and Asset Management to move customers through onboarding.
Build long-term relationships that generate repeat business and referrals.
Manage your territory, pipeline and results.
What We’re Looking For 
You have 2+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in an outside sales or new-business role. Experience in fleet, automotive, equipment finance, commercial banking or financial services is an asset, but not required. We can teach you our business.
More importantly, you:
Are competitive, curious and motivated to create your own opportunities.
Are comfortable prospecting, picking up the phone and hearing “no.”
Can earn trust with owners, CFOs and senior executives.
Ask good questions and understand how a customer’s business works.
Can turn financial and operational information into a clear business case.
Follow through, stay organized and take ownership.
Have a valid driver’s license and are legally able to work in Canada.
Why JPC? 
You’ll have the opportunity to build your own book of business with the backing of a company that has been doing this for more than 35 years.
First-year earning opportunity is $85,000–$115,000 while you learn the business and build your pipeline. Commission is uncapped, with established Account Executives earning $200,000+ .
You’ll receive a 10-month development program covering finance, fleet and asset management, and practical B2B selling.
Company vehicle and fuel card, laptop, cell phone, comprehensive benefits and health spending account are included.
Ready to Build Something?  
If you're motivated by earning potential, long-term client relationships and the autonomy to build your own territory, we'd like to meet you. 
Please take 5 minutes to complete this survey, your application will not be considered without it: https://secure.personex.com/profile/default.aspx?LANG=ENG&ClientID=b2179a9d-1a2f-11ec-ae9c-165fb6ab0828&uc=LXFFB3PG&QVersion=1

public.title: Senior Living Management Intern
public.description:
About the program: 
The Senior Living Management internship will be a full-time (40 hours/week) opportunity for 12 weeks from May to August. The Senior Living Management Intern is responsible for assisting the Executive Director and Administrator in the overall administration of the community. S/he also handles special projects for the Executive Director and Senior Leadership team members at the community. 
As part of the internship program, students will gain additional skills to prepare them for entering the job market, including interviewing, presentations, and performance evaluation to further enhance their experience. 
Experience is Everything; 
At LCS, experience is everything. We provide you the opportunity to use your talents in a progressive, growing organization that makes a positive difference in the lives of the seniors we serve. If you are seeking an organization that gives back, you’ll love working here. Our principles and hospitality promises define our company culture. LCS employees can be found participating in volunteer activities, getting involved in our committees or collaborating with team members in our innovative workspace. You’ll find several opportunities to grow as a professional, serve the community, and enhance the lives of the seniors. 
What You’ll Do: 
Attend and participate in department head meetings, care plan meetings, daily health center “stand up” meetings, board meetings, and other resident meetings as requested by the Executive Director. 
Make weekly environmental rounds (plant, kitchen, environmental services). 
Assist Administrator in preparing for yearly fire-safety and resident care survey inspections in the Health Center and Assisted Living areas. 
Conduct audits on a variety of Health Center documentation, including resident charts, MARs, TARs, pain assessments, etc. 
Attend interviews, counseling sessions, trainings and other personnel meetings. 
Attend marketing events as requested by the Executive Director. 
Prepare monthly financial variance reports for the Executive Director. 
Complete a variety of projects as prescribed by the Executive Director. 
What we’re looking for: 
Minimum of 1-2 years completed towards bachelor’s degree preferred. 
Currently enrolled in a college or university program majoring in Healthcare Management, Business, Nursing, Geriatrics, or related program. 
Interest in Senior Living operations is ideal 
Exposure to hospitality, or related field is a plus. 
Why join us? 
Hands-on experience in a professional environment 
Mentorship and exposure to senior leadership 
Opportunities for networking and career development 
Meaningful project work that makes an impact 
Competitive hourly rate: $22.50/hour 
Our Commitment 
LCS creates living experiences that enhance the lives of seniors. You’ll see this commitment in our people. They’re talented, dedicated professionals who truly care about residents, with each conducting his or her work with integrity, honesty and transparency according to the principles of LCS. We strive to help every community succeed—strengthening available resources, establishing proven practices that lead to long-term growth and value for those living in, working for and affiliated with the community. Check us out on our website: https://www.lcsliving.com 
A POST-OFFER BACKGROUND CHECK, INCLUDING REFERENCES IS REQUIRED. 
LCS IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.

public.title: Tier 2 Network Technician
public.description:
The Digital Modernization Sector at Leidos has an opening for a Tier II Network Technician  to support computer data communications systems, in providing design specifications, testing and inspections for computer networks; plan and implementing upgrades; as well as, analyzing and organizing corresponding hardware and software combined solutions through network modeling.
The job duties of the Tier II Network Technician are as follows:
The Tier 2 network field technician will support the installation and maintenance of the client LAN/WAN devices.
Respond to and resolve incident tickets.
Draft and implement standard network change requests.
Provide support to Tier III network engineers for incident management and projects (site surveys, TEMS, coordinate and install new equipment).

public.title: Research Scientist
public.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 



Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.


The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.


Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 



The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 



We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.



Outset builds digital twins: AI systems that represent specific real people and respond to research questions the way those people would. The Digital Twins Team runs an ongoing research program to measure and improve how faithfully these systems reproduce human responses and behavior, across a range of cross-sectional levels of analysis.

The Research Scientist works directly with and reports to the Head Scientist. Together you will choose what to study, design the studies, define how results are measured, interpret the findings, and write them up for internal decision-making and, where appropriate, for academic publication. You will bring current methodological training in computational social science, data science, survey-methodology, human-computation interaction, and experiment design.

Responsibilities 

 - Co-design and run studies that compare system-generated responses with responses from humans, using both qualitative and quantitative measures.

 - Design, justify, and hone measures of performance.

 - Apply and adapt state-of-the-art statistical techniques common to survey methodology and large-scale social data analysis, to benchmark and improve sample- and population-level simulation performance.

 - Design evaluations and experiments with pre-specified analysis plans.

 - Design and oversee human rating studies, including rater training, coding rubrics, and inter-rater agreement measurement.

 - Design data collection from third-party data sources and directly from human participants, including longitudinal and repeated-measures studies.

 - Contribute to the research agenda for new modeling approaches, including evaluation of fine-tuned models and of model calibration.

 - Specify analyses precisely enough for an engineer to implement.

 - Co-author papers, preprints, and presentations.

Qualifications

 - A completed or nearly completed PhD in computational social science, communication, HCI, sociology, political science, psychology, statistics, or a related field.

 - Peer-reviewed publications on which you were a primary author.

 - Working command of graduate-level statistical methodology common to social science, including the assumptions behind each.

 - Experience analyzing large-scale telemetry and behavioral datasets, with attention to the validity of the resulting inference.

 - Familiarity with machine learning, spanning classical, nonparametric, and LLM-based approaches, including how transformer-based language models work, what fine-tuning does, and how the major model families differ.

 - Fundamentals of computing: file systems, software libraries, databases, SQL, and tabular data.

 - Ability to work in an environment where most code is produced through agentic coding tools, and to read and check that code.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience fine-tuning open-weight language models on survey, experimental, or behavioral data.

 - Experience building or evaluating calibrated confidence or error-prediction models, including deriving decision thresholds from human judgments.

 - Experience measuring similarity of open-ended text, for example with embedding-based methods.

 - Experience designing or running panel-based data collection with human participants.

 - Experience presenting research at academic and/or industry conferences.

 - Prior work on generative agents, digital twins, or simulation of human respondents.

 - Familiarity with the startup ecosystem

 - Familiarity with qualitative interviews and ethnographic methods

 - Familiarity with topics in computational linguistics

Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 



Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.


The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.


Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 



The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 



We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.



Outset builds digital twins: AI systems that represent specific real people and respond to research questions the way those people would. The Research Engineer reports to the Head Scientist and builds and maintains the systems that let the team's scientists run their studies correctly, reproducibly, and at scale. The scientists design the studies and define the measurements; you make sure every experiment executes exactly as designed, that results can be reproduced from stored inputs, and that research code stays in step with the shipped product. The ideal candidate has supported scientists in an academic computational social science lab or a comparable research setting and has hands-on experience engineering systems built on large language models.

Responsibilities 

 - Own the evaluation infrastructure that tests competing modeling approaches, so that new tests can be set up quickly, run concurrently and automatically, and be monitored.

 - Implement measurement pipelines exactly as specified by the scientists, with deterministic and traceable outputs.

 - Maintain versioned evaluation datasets with held-out sets that are never used for training.

 - Keep research code in step with the production product so that validated improvements ship promptly.

 - Detect and prevent threats to the validity of evaluations.

 - Track compute and API spend across experiments and their implications for production-stage costs

 - Manage repositories, code review, documentation, and the reproducibility of the team's coding workflow.

 - Identify implementation choices that can be made more correct or more efficient, and propose changes.

Qualifications

 - Several years of software engineering experience, including experience supporting researchers in a lab or comparable setting.

 - Experience translating specific scientific requirements and experiment designs into code.

 - Experience building and operating large-scale data pipelines on human behavior data, and confirming that the pipelines matched the criteria and design the researchers specified.

 - Strong Python, including the ability to read and audit code produced by agentic coding tools.

 - Fundamentals of computing: file systems, software libraries, databases, SQL, tabular data, and Git-based workflows.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure and with running many jobs concurrently.

 - Working understanding of machine learning, including how transformer-based language models behave, how model APIs are used, and what fine-tuning involves.

 - A habit of writing deterministic, reproducible, cost-aware, and well-documented code.


PREFERRED

With two main campuses (Vancouver and the Okanagan), more than 73,000 students, 20,000 faculty and staff, and a balanced annual budget over $4 billion, UBC is an institution of remarkable breadth and depth that is distinguished by its world-class research and societal impact.
UBC’s commitment to fostering an outstanding student experience and vibrant learning community is articulated in both the institution’s Strategic Directions 2025-2030 and its recently launched Student Strategic Plan 2026-2029 . UBC also is the largest provider of student housing in Canada, with accommodation for more than 16,000 students across the Vancouver and Okanagan campuses.

Applications are sought from executive leaders who have a substantial, successful, and proven track record leading a complex and diverse students’ portfolio in a large, research based academic institution, experience that preferably spans a multi campus environment is a strong asset. public.title: Asbestos Surveyor
public.description:
Asbestos Surveyor
Riverside Environmental Services 
Who we are 
Riverside Environmental Services is one of the UK's leading asbestos consultancies, delivering high quality asbestos surveying, analytical and consultancy services to a diverse portfolio of clients across commercial, residential, industrial and public sector environments.
We pride ourselves on doing things the right way – investing in our people, maintaining the highest technical standards and building long-term relationships with both our clients and employees. As we continue to grow across London and the South East, we are looking for experienced Asbestos Surveyors to join a business where your development is genuinely supported and your contribution is recognised.
Part of the Celnor Group 
Celnor Group is a UK-based environmental services group operating across the Testing, Inspection, Certification and Compliance (TICC) landscape. With a growing portfolio of specialist businesses, Celnor provides essential services that protect people, property and the environment.
While each business retains its own identity, culture and technical specialism, all are supported by a central group function that invests in people, systems and long-term sustainable growth.
Job details 
This role is central to the day-to-day success of the business and contributes directly to operational performance and customer outcomes
At Riverside, we're committed to developing careers, not just filling vacancies. 
We actively invest in our people, offering clear progression routes into Lead Surveyor, Team Leader, Auditing, Project Lead and Project Management positions. Through our dedicated training school, you'll have the opportunity to support and mentor new surveyors and analysts while developing your own leadership skills. We also support additional qualifications such as P403, P404, P405 and other industry-recognised courses, ensuring you can continue to grow your technical expertise within a business where your contribution is valued and you're treated as a person, not a number.
What you will do 
Conduct Management, Refurbishment and Demolition asbestos surveys.
Collect accurate site information and asbestos samples.
Produce high quality survey reports and technical documentation.
Work across a varied portfolio of domestic, commercial and industrial sites.
Build positive relationships with clients and site stakeholders.
Maintain compliance with company procedures and industry standards.
Support and mentor trainee surveyors.
Contribute to continuous improvement, compliance and quality standards.
Who you are 
You are an experienced and motivated professional who takes pride in delivering quality work and maintaining high standards. You will ideally have:
BOHS P402 qualification or equivalent.
Previous experience carrying out asbestos surveys.
A strong understanding of HSG264 and asbestos legislation.
A full UK driving licence.
A high level of attention to detail and accountability.
Join us 
You’ll be joining a business where your contribution matters and where professionalism, integrity and teamwork are genuinely valued. As part of the wider Celnor Group, you’ll benefit from group-wide investment, shared expertise and opportunities to develop your career as the organisation continues to grow.
Benefits 
Annual leave entitlement of 20 days plus bank holidays, with the opportunity to earn up to 5 additional loyalty days.
Life Assurance scheme providing Death in Service cover of 2x annual salary following successful completion of 6 months' service.
Company vehicle available for both business and personal use, or a car allowance option, with a fuel card provided.
Company pension scheme operated through salary exchange.
Access to an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) offering confidential wellbeing and support services.
Ongoing training and professional development fully funded through recognised industry training providers.
Clear career progression opportunities with structured development pathways across the business.
Full provision of high-quality equipment, including smartphone, tablet, tools and all required PPE.
Employee recognition and reward initiatives, including vouchers, experiences and performance-based awards. 
Access to exclusive employee discounts and benefits through BenefitHub.
A positive team culture with regular social events, charity initiatives and company gatherings, including annual summer BBQs.
Important information 
Celnor Group and its businesses manage recruitment directly. We do not require agency support for this role and will only engage with recruitment partners from our preferred supplier list where necessary.
We may use technology, including AI-enabled tools, to support parts of the recruitment process. AI is not used for candidate screening, scoring or hiring decisions. All hiring decisions are made by people, for people. Our recruitment systems are ISO 42001 accredited, reflecting our commitment to ethical, transparent and responsible use of technology.

public.title: Public Equity Investment Intern - Summer 2027
public.description:
Founded in 1999, Viking Global Investors (“Viking”) is a global investment firm with a long-term, fundamental, research-intensive approach to investing. Viking manages more than $56 billion of capital across public and private investments. Viking has offices in Stamford, New York, Hong Kong, London, and San Francisco, and is registered as an investment adviser with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. For more information, please visit vikingglobal.com .
INTERNSHIP OPPORTUNITY 
Join our 27-person public equity investment team this summer to develop your investing toolkit and explore actionable investment ideas. Throughout your 10-week experience, you will partner directly with portfolio managers and senior analysts to identify and evaluate public equity investment opportunities leveraging our fundamental, research-intensive approach. You will be trained and mentored by experienced investors at Viking to ensure your success. The internship will culminate with an investment presentation to members of the investment team.
RESPONSIBILITIES 
Performing primary, in-depth research on industry and company fundamentals by analyzing financial statements and real-time data, conducting channel checks and surveys, and carrying out other comprehensive due diligence activities
Engaging with company management and investor relations teams, sell-side research analysts and buy-side peers
Attending industry conferences and events
Building and updating financial models
Distilling a large volume of research down to a set of key drivers of industry, company, and stock price performance to form a view on a company and its value
Contributing to Viking’s overall research effort by sharing information and insights with the investment team
QUALIFICATIONS 
Across the firm, we attract motivated, intellectually curious, and analytically rigorous people who are passionate about learning and creating impact. 
The ideal candidate will possess the following traits:
Independence of thought: we strive to be unbiased and develop objective, data-centric theses to drive investment decisions.
Strong quantitative and analytical abilities: has the intellectual toolkit to support investment theses with highly differentiated research.
Efficient communication: our research efforts are extensive, but our ideas are communicated clearly and simply.
Autonomous and self-starting: we are a team of high-performing, motivated investment professionals; we are proactive and direct our own work.
Intellectual honesty: we value the ability to see the truth, even amidst confusion and conflict. We strive to recognize the current, correct investment decision rather than simply continuing to advocate for prior recommendations.
Passion for research and investing: our team is engaged and excited to pursue differentiated research, supported by the firm’s significant resources.
APPLICATION 
Please submit a 1–2 page supplement making the case for a controversial investment idea: a view on a publicly traded company, industry, or investment theme where you believe the market consensus is wrong. State your position clearly in the first sentence, including the direction of your view and the time horizon over which you expect it to play out.
Your supplement should:
Explain what the consensus believes today and why you disagree
Focus on the elements you consider most misunderstood or underappreciated
Address the strongest argument against your view and explain why it is wrong
Identify what developments would tell you that you are right or wrong
We value conviction and original analysis over a balanced summary of the debate. Evidence you have gathered yourself is encouraged. Please select a topic outside of industries or businesses you’ve analyzed professionally in prior roles.
Eligibility & Requirements 
At this time, we are only accepting applications from first-year MBA candidates.
The internship is currently based in New York.
Application deadline: December 3, 2026 (11:59PM ET).
The base salary range for this position in New York City is annual $250,000 to $250,000 . In addition to base salary, Viking employees may be eligible for other forms of compensation and benefits, such as a discretionary bonus, 100% coverage of medical and dental premiums, and paid lunches. Actual compensation for successful candidates will be individually determined based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s skill set, experience, education, and other qualifications. For more information on our benefits, please visit www.vikingglobal.com/life-at-viking/ 
Viking is an equal opportunity employer. Questions about your candidacy and requests for reasonable accommodation in the recruitment process should be directed to campusrecruiting@vikingglobal.com .

Job Description: 
Role title: Registered Nurse  
Role type:  Full Time - Perm Part Time available 
Department and location:  St Vincent’s Private Hospital Sydney  
Salary: From $41.58 - $58.40 per hour + super depending on experience 
Welcome to St Vincent’s Private Hospital Sydney, Sydney’s premier inner-city private hospital 
Join a team built on a proud legacy of world-class care, true compassion, and deep community roots. 
Founded in 1857 by the Sisters of Charity and powered today by St Vincent’s Health Australia, the Sisters' legacy of compassionate service is our living heartbeat. As a world-class tertiary facility, we are at the forefront of medical innovation, featuring high-acuity interventional suites, next-gen surgical robotics for complex specialties, and cutting-edge oncology backed by the renowned Kinghorn Cancer Centre. Here, you will work alongside global leaders and access funded postgraduate pathways to accelerate your career. 
Located in the vibrant heart of Darlinghurst, we are positioned just minutes from Kings Cross station, with direct, high-frequency bus connections from the east, and seamless links from Gadigal and Museum stations right to our doorstep. 
Read on to explore this exciting role and the fantastic perks waiting for you here. 
The role: 
We are seeking a highly motivated RN with at least 2 years of experience in critical care as well as a post graduate qualification in ICU to join our ICU team at Sydney Private Hospital Sydney.
This rewarding opportunity will see you join our staff at St Vincent’s Private Hospital Sydney (SVPHS) located in Darlinghurst. This role can be full time working 38 hours per week and will be pivotal in the delivery of expert care to a diverse cohort of surgical and medical patients within the ICU. We are also open to part-time 24 hours a week etc. 
You will bring your passion to the role where you will work with a dedicated team of registered nurses, RN new graduates, nursing students, clinical nurse educators, patient care orderlies/AINs and medical teams.

As an experienced Critical Care RN you will 
Think critically and analyse nursing practice 
Engage in therapeutic and professional relationships 
Maintain the capability for practice 
Comprehensively conduct nursing assessments 
Provide safe, appropriate and responsive quality nursing practice 
Current AHPRA Registration minimum of 2 years 
Recent acute clinical experience (medical, surgical, HDU, ED, or theatre recovery/PACU)
Ability to manage deteriorating patients
Critical thinking and strong assessment skills
Postgraduate Cert in critical care - or willingness to work towards 
What we can offer you at St Vincent’s Private Hospital Sydney 
Exceptional Rewards: Highly competitive base pay, plus exclusive not-for-profit salary packaging perks. Enjoy pre-tax savings on up to $15,900 for everyday living costs (mortgage, rent, bills) plus $2,650 for dining out and entertainment annually

For-Purpose Impact: Be part of a not-for-profit where surplus is reinvested into research & community care 
World-Class : Collaborate with global leaders across more than 100 medical specialties and 60 service areas 
Surgical Innovation: Work with eminent surgeons using next-gen robotics in cardiac, neuro & orthopaedic 
Premium Care: Deliver deeply personalised, patient-centred care in a 100% private-room en-suite facility 
Safe Staffing: Work with peace of mind under an historic EA delivering mandated nurse-to-patient ratios 
Professional Growth: Accelerate your career with clinical education programs & funded postgrad pathways 
Health & Wellbeing: Fitness Passport, discounted private health, & cultural recognitions and celebrations 
Sponsorship / work rights for Australia 
Please note, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. For this role you must be an Australian or New Zealand citizen or have an Australia visa that grants you the work rights necessary for the role.

We celebrate diversity & inclusion and are committed to equal employment opportunity for everyone. 
As part of our commitment to reconciliation, we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to apply and join us in delivering care that heals body, mind, spirit and community. 
Shortlisting for this position will commence immediately. We encourage you to apply promptly as the advertisement may close early should a suitable applicant be sourced.

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting how your interest, skills, and experience align with each of the things listed in the About You section of this job advert.  
Respectfully, this role is not open to recruitment agencies.

public.title: Contracts Specialist
public.description:
Contract Specialist 
This position requires an active CBP Public Trust clearance or the ability to obtain a CBP Public Trust clearance to be considered. 
The Contract Specialist shall provide advice, recommendations, and document support in all areas of the acquisition requirements phase. The Contractor shall assist in the development and review of contract requirements documentation to include Statements of Work (SOW), Statements of Objectives (SOO), and Performance Work Statements (PWS). 
Compensation & Benefits: 
Estimated Starting Salary Range for Contract Specialist: $125K to $135K 
Pay commensurate with experience. 
Full time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice. 
Contract Specialist Responsibilities Include: 
Provide acquisition support services that are not inherently Governmental to include technical support to the evaluation process, and assistance to the Government in developing documentation in all areas of the pre-award acquisition phase. 
Advise the Government on the best procurement approach and assist in Market Research analysis and documentation. The Contractor shall be aware of all CBP Procurement policies and what documentation is required for each acquisition 
Assist the program office in conducting market research to identify potential sources and contract vehicles, preparing market surveys and developing written announcements. Potential sources include socio- economic program participants (i.e., small businesses, small and disadvantaged businesses, Historically Underutilized Business (HUB) Zone businesses), and potential contract vehicles may include General Services Administration (GSA) Schedule vendors, Government-wide Agency Contracts, and other agency contracts.
Assist in the preparation and development of all pre-award documentation including: Source Selection Plans (SSP), instructions for Source Selection Evaluation Board (SSEB) members on roles and responsibilities, Determinations and Findings (D&F), Justifications and Approvals (J&A) and other necessary contract file documents. 
Work with evaluators and the Contracting Officer (CO) to assist in identifying pre-negotiation objectives and assist the CO with discussions with Offerors. The Contractor shall thoroughly review proposals, identity issues with respect to the proposals, provide input for developing a negotiating position, and provide cost or price analysis of the proposal when required. 
Prepare negotiation memorandum supporting each contract action. These documents will fully address all salient issues associated with the procurement, the key decision items, and all pre-award reviews performed to comply with policy and regulation. The Contractor shall also ensure that the files prepared for the pre-award decisions are thorough and address all applicable regulatory, policy and internal operating requirements; filed consistent with DHS and CBP policy; and are properly organized to facilitate various post- award reviews and administration. 
Assist in developing draft Request for Quotes (RFQ), Request for Proposals (RFP), and/or Combined Synopsis/Solicitations for Government approval. The Contractor shall assure the solicitation includes all appropriate terms and conditions and recommend and prepare unique terms and conditions as required. Prior to the release of the solicitation, the Contractor shall assist in verifying that funds are available, obtaining legal concurrence, and releasing the solicitation by electronic posting, email, fax or mail upon approval by the CO. 
Assist in preparing final contract award documents for task and delivery orders, stand-alone contracts, and Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR) designation letters, obtaining legal concurrence, and distributing the contract to the appropriate parties. The Contractor shall prepare draft award announcements for electronic posting and draft Congressional Notifications in accordance with FAR requirements and DHS/CBP guidance. 
Provide advice, recommendations, and document support in all areas of the post-award acquisition phase. The Contractor shall assist in preparing appropriate documentation for negotiated contract modifications and in monitoring performance and compliance with terms of all assigned contracts, including site visits, periodic program reviews, labor interviews, support to award fee evaluations, and initiation of Contractor Performance Assessment Reporting Systems documentation. 
Contract Specialist Experience, Education, Skills, Abilities requested: 
Bachelor’s Degree required. 
5 or more years of Government Contract Specialist experience required. 
Experience with construction contracting highly desired. 
Contract Specialist 1102 certification is required. 
Experience with SAP is required. 
Utilizing and applying computer software including Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint). 
Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
The ability to obtain a CBP Public Trust Clearance. 
Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal 
Company Information: 
Cherokee Nation Strategic Program (CNSP) provides support, services, and solutions to federal and commercial customers. The company takes a personalized approach to solving our clients' toughest challenges, helping you make the most of your skills. CNSP is part of Cherokee Federal – a team of tribally owned federal contracting companies. For more information, visit cherokee-federal.com. 
#CherokeeFederal #LI #LI-Remote 
Legal Disclaimer: Cherokee Federal is an equal opportunity employer. Please visit cherokee-federal.com/careers for information regarding our Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer Statement, and Accommodation request.

public.title: Network Operations- Tier 2- Clearance Sponsorship
public.description:
Job Title: Network Operations- Tier 2- Clearance Sponsorship 
Job Category: Information Technology 
Time Type: Full time 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph 
Employee Type: Regular 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
* * * 
The Opportunity: 
The Enterprise Communications Services 3 (ECS3) program supports our intel customer across its many operating locations. Our focus is to assist the organization to technically transform it's current services by leading edge technology insertions. To accomplish this, we are charged with development of new designs, its implementation, and operation of the new and or enhanced services. Over the life of the contract, we will drive continual service improvement by tech modernization, for our (LANs), wide area networks (WAN), unified communication (UC), video telecommunication and streaming services.  
Responsibilities: 
As a Tier 2 Network Operations technician, you'll be challenged with enterprise support problems where you will coordinate with the Network Operations Center and other operational staff to address break/fix, configuration update, schedule add moves and changes, and technology upgrades and installs for Network routers and switches. As an experienced network team member, you’ll be expected to coordinate ticket acceptance and resolutions. You will support the development of technical resolution reports for critical outages in the Network.
More About the Role:  
In this role the Network Administrator will be responsible for: 
Conduct approved network changes to include but not limited to VLan, ACL and port assignment.
Perform IOS upgrades to routers and switches.
Perform routing and switching equipment technology upgrades to ensure continued operations of the enterprise.
Draft Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) for network operations.
Resolve systems failures and accessibility problems within the network to our services.
Support site survey and engineering designs data calls.
Support new/enhanced network implementation, installation, and technical refresh projects within a site or locale.
Works independently with some supervision.
In remote locations must function as independent engineering, maintenance, and network problem solving with minimal or intermittent input from other Tiers/locations. 
Problems faced are difficult, will require detailed information gathering, analysis, and investigation to understand problems. You will employ creativity and ingenuity for new technical solutions applicable across the enterprise, drawing heavily on prior experience.
Perform Network ticket resolution.
Support Network ticket closure across Network Operations staff to include:
Use administrative access to the network to provision new switches, routers, and Cryptographic devices.
Uses administrative access to network components to research errors, incidents, problems and to perform incident analysis and identify potential problems. 
Routing Service Requests to the appropriate organization required for incident resolution.
Performs root cause analyses.
Completes problem resolutions associated with incident ticket(s)
Review and implementation of Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs).
Qualifications: 
Required:  
IAT II (Ex: Security+)
CCNA
Active TS/SCI with polygraph clearance OR TS/SCI clearance with the ability to obtain a polygraph prior to starting.
10+ Years of relevant experience (Bachelor’s Degree in applicable field may be substituted for 5 years of experience).
Familiarity with both Cisco and Juniper network devices
Strong working knowledge of the various routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, VRF, MPLS, 802.1x).
In-depth knowledge of KG-175 Series TACLANES configuration process, fault isolation, and firmware upgrade procedures.
Working knowledge of Cisco-ISE.
- 
What You Can Expect: 
A culture of integrity. 
At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
An environment of trust. 
CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
A focus on continuous growth. 
Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
Pay Range : 
There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$86,600 - $181,800 
CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

public.title: Revenue Manager
public.description:
Job Summary 
Omninet Capital is seeking an experienced, commercially minded Revenue Manager to lead pricing strategy and revenue optimization across our multifamily portfolio. This role owns revenue management processes, renewal strategies, market intelligence, and actionable performance insights for both existing properties and new acquisitions. 
Working closely with Asset Management, Regional Managers, and onsite teams, the Revenue Manager will lead pricing discussions, translate market and property-level data into decisions, and drive improvements in occupancy, rental revenue, and net operating income (NOI). 
Responsibilities 
Revenue Management & Pricing Strategy 
Own portfolio pricing and revenue management strategy, including revenue management platform configuration, pricing parameters, lease terms, amenity premiums, and data integrity. 
Set and adjust rental pricing by property, floor plan, unit type, and renovation level to balance occupancy, leasing velocity, and rent growth. 
Lead renewal pricing and offer strategy, monitoring retention, lease expirations, exposure, and revenue impact. 
Evaluate concessions and promotions and direct timely adjustments based on performance and market conditions. 
Identify and implement ancillary revenue opportunities, including parking, laundry, technology fees, and other income streams. 
Acquisitions & Asset Strategy 
Partner with Asset Management and Operations on acquisition underwriting, market rent assumptions, pricing strategies, and Year 1 revenue plans. 
Develop revenue strategies for new acquisitions, lease-ups, repositioning, and stabilization, including opportunities from unit renovations, amenity premiums, and ancillary income. 
Proactively identify underperforming assets and develop actionable revenue improvement plans with property leadership. 
Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis 
Oversee market surveys and competitive sets, including competitor outreach and property visits. 
Analyze rent comparables, new supply, demand, employment trends, and submarket dynamics to inform portfolio pricing decisions. 
Anticipate market shifts and communicate risks and opportunities with recommended actions. 
Financial Analysis & Performance Reporting 
Own revenue models, dashboards, forecasts, and recurring portfolio reporting, translating results into clear recommendations for leadership. 
Monitor occupancy, effective rents, lease trade-outs, renewal conversion, concessions, leasing velocity, and revenue growth. 
Lead weekly pricing and renewal meetings and partner with Asset Management on budget performance, forecasts, and business plans. 
Technology, Process Improvement & Collaboration 
Establish portfolio revenue management standards, reporting procedures, controls, and pricing best practices. 
Coach Regional Managers and onsite teams on pricing execution and effective use of revenue management tools. 
Leverage AI, automation, and analytics to strengthen forecasting, streamline reporting, and improve decision-making. 
Qualifications 
5–10 years of progressive experience in multifamily revenue management, pricing, asset management, or closely related real estate functions, including substantial hands-on responsibility for portfolio revenue strategy. 
Demonstrated experience owning multifamily pricing decisions and leading revenue management discussions across multiple properties. 
Hands-on expertise with multifamily revenue management platforms such as YieldStar/AIRM, LRO, or comparable systems required. 
Strong knowledge of multifamily operations, leasing economics, occupancy management, concessions, and renewal strategy. 
Working knowledge of Yardi and EliseAI preferred; advanced Excel and financial modeling required. Experience with Power BI or similar tools preferred; SQL a plus. 
Strong business judgment, executive communication, stakeholder influence, and the ability to coach property teams without direct reporting authority. 
Experience supporting acquisitions, lease-ups, repositioning, or asset stabilization strongly preferred. 
Comfort using AI and automation tools responsibly, including validating outputs and applying sound commercial judgment. 
Ability to travel to properties up to 25% of the time. 
Location:  Dallas, TX (HQ2) 
Job Type:  Regular, Full-Time 
Compensation Range:  $95,000-$120,000 base salary, consumerate on experience, + annual performance bonus 
Omninet Capital, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. 
About Omninet Capital LLC 
Omninet Capital is a vertically integrated private real estate investment and property management firm headquartered in Beverly Hills, California. Founded and led by its principals, the firm owns and operates a diversified portfolio of multifamily and commercial assets across the United States, with approximately 300 professionals managing the platform end-to-end — from acquisitions, capital markets, and asset management to property operations, construction, accounting, legal, and technology. 
Our edge is operational. Because we underwrite, close, and operate our own assets, every member of the acquisitions team works alongside the people ultimately responsible for executing the business plan. We combine institutional rigor with the speed and conviction of a principal investor, while increasingly leveraging AI and automation to accelerate underwriting, sharpen decision-making, and uncover opportunities others miss.
