public.description:
About UNTUCKit 
Founded on the premise that you can dress casually and still look sharp, UNTUCKit was the first to make Shirts Designed to be Worn Untucked back in 2011. Today, we make shirts, polos, Henley, tees, pants, dresses, shoes, and accessories for all shapes and sizes. We’re headquartered in New York’s SoHo neighborhood, with 70+ stores.The UNTUCKit team is made up of unique, inspiring, and fun-loving members, all of whom help make the brand what it is today. We value each other’s diversity and expertise, while sharing a common thread of dedication, inclusion, and a passion for polished, casual style.
Human Resources Generalist 
We are seeking a systems-savvy HR Generalist to provide day-to-day HR partnership and operational support for our NYC corporate office and retail stores across multiple locations. This role supports the full associate lifecycle—from recruiting, onboarding, and employee relations to workforce administration, reporting, and off-boarding. The ideal candidate has a curiosity to find solutions and improve processes. They are organized, solutions-oriented, and experienced with high-volume retail store support. 
Key Responsibilities
Recruiting & Talent Acquisition: Partner with the corporate Talent Acquisition team and hiring leaders on corporate hiring. Lead and coordinate high-volume retail store recruitment with store managers, using the applicant tracking system to manage requisitions and candidate flow. Maintain accurate requisition details and current job descriptions and participate in interviews as needed.
Associate Experience & Lifecycle: Coordinate onboarding from pre communication through orientation and check-ins and keep onboarding programs and materials current. Oversee hiring procedures and background checks, coordinate offboarding, and conduct and document exit interviews for retail and corporate associates.
Employee Relations & Leader Support: Respond to associate questions and concerns with empathy, consistency, and urgency. Advise and coach store leaders and associates on workplace concerns, performance expectations, and corrective action. Support employee relations matters and participate in workplace investigations in coordination with HR team and Legal, escalating complex issues when appropriate.
Performance Management & Talent Programs: Coordinate the annual performance review process, engagement surveys, internship programs, and other HR initiatives and events. Coach leaders on delivering constructive feedback and managing performance.
HR Operations, Systems & Reporting: Administer employee lifecycle transactions in ADP, including new hires, employee changes, and separations. Maintain accurate HRIS data, personnel files, organizational charts, and confidential records. Prepare HR reports and analytical insights for HR and business leaders.
Compliance, Policies & Leave Support: Support compliance with applicable federal, New York State, New York City, and other relevant state and local employment requirements. Help administer policies and processes, including NYC pay transparency and Paid Safe and Sick Leave requirements, Form I-9 compliance, workplace safety documentation, OSHA reporting, internal audits, and other applicable requirements. Guide associates through leave-of-absence and policy processes and partner with Benefits team to resolve any questions.
Workforce Planning & Business Partnership: Partner with Operations, Finance, Compensation, and HR leadership on headcount planning, compensation activity, and payroll budget support. Balance urgent field needs with corporate deadlines and contribute to continuous improvement of HR processes 
Requirements 
Qualifications & Skills
· Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
· At least 3 years of HR experience in a fast-paced environment; 3–5 years of experience in a multi-unit retail, corporate, or similarly fast-paced business is preferred.
· Hands-on employee relations experience and a strong working knowledge of applicable employment laws, including New York City and New York State requirements and multi-state compliance.
· Experience with HRIS data and systems; ADP experience preferred. Workable or another applicant tracking system is highly preferred.
· Proficiency in Microsoft Office and comfort learning new systems. Experience with Excel pivot tables, lookup functions, or similar analytical tools is a plus.
· Ability to use AI-enabled productivity tools responsibly to support research, analysis, drafting, and workflow efficiency.
· Strong judgment, problem-solving, organization, project management, communication, and relationship-building skills, with exceptional accuracy and attention to detail.
· Demonstrated empathy, coaching ability, discretion, confidentiality, adaptability, and professionalism; able to work independently and collaboratively and interact confidently with leaders at all levels.
· Strong business acumen and the ability to manage high-volume retail support while meeting corporate priorities and deadlines.
· This position follows a hybrid schedule, with on-site work in the New York City office Tuesday through Thursday and remote flexibility on Mondays and Fridays unless business needs require a change.
· Salary range: $75,000-$85,000 plus bonus.
Our Core Values:
· Be Kind: Approach each other as we do our customers with respect and gratitude
· Own it: Be accountable for your work. If you see an opportunity for improvement, seize it.

What you'll do: 
Cultivate a culture of Enlightened Hospitality for all stakeholders that supports our business objectives and growth
Develop and implement employee benefits programs: The Benefits Manager researches, designs, and implements employee benefits programs. This includes health insurance, retirement plans, and other employee perks, such as wellness programs.
Communicate benefits information: The Benefits Manager communicates benefits information to USHG employees, including plan details, enrollment deadlines, and changes to the program. They may also provide training to employees on how to use the benefits program.
Monitor benefits trends: The Benefits Manager stays current on changes in laws and regulations related to employee benefits. They also monitor industry trends and make recommendations to improve the benefits program.
Manage vendor relationships: The Benefits Manager works with insurance providers, retirement plan administrators, and other vendors to negotiate contracts and ensure that services are delivered efficiently.
Analyze benefits data: The Benefits Manager analyzes benefits data to assess the effectiveness of the program and identify areas for improvement. They may also conduct surveys to gather feedback from employees about the benefits program.
Ensure compliance: The Benefits Manager ensures that the benefits program is compliant with all relevant laws and regulations, including the Affordable Care Act (ACA) and the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA).
Collaborate with other teams: The Benefits Manager works with other teams, such as People, payroll, and finance, to ensure that the benefits program is integrated with other systems and processes.
Manage budget: The Benefits Manager manages the budget for the benefits program, including forecasting costs, monitoring expenses, and making recommendations for cost-saving measures. Communicates, promotes, and continues to evaluate our internal transfer/promotion process to support both business needs and employee growth needs
Vendor Relationships: The Benefits Manager will work and collaborate with the following vendors: BRI, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Fidelity, Cigna, Davis Vision, Wagmo, Unum, EB Cohen 
What we need from you: 
3-5 years of experience managing benefits preferably in the hospitality industry
Proficient in HR systems and extensive knowledge of benefits packages, policies, and legislation
Must be able to communicate effectively with senior leaders, build trust, credibility, and influence by example
Must have strong written, and verbal presentation and negotiation skills.
Sound HR judgment and sense of urgency
Keen understanding of the hospitality industry and the culture and beliefs of Union Square Hospitality Group
Knowledge of compensation and wage guidelines a plus
Bachelor's degree or relevant work experience required. SHRM Certification and UKG experience are a plus
What you'll get from us: 
At Union Square Hospitality Group,  extending Enlightened Hospitality is at the heart of everything we do. We believe our people are our greatest ingredient. Joining our team means becoming part of a culture rooted in care, creativity, and growth. As a Benefits Manager, you'll enjoy: 
Competitive pay and bonus potential : Annual compensation of $75,000 - $85,000 plus eligibility for a performance-based bonus, with consideration for your experience and impact 
Comprehensive health coverage :  Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible spending options for healthcare and dependent care 
Time to recharge: Generous paid time off and paid parental leave to support life outside of work

Peace of mind : Life insurance, employee assistance programs, and exclusive access to primary care, mental health, and other wellness services. 
Support in times of need: Access to the USHG HUGS Employee Relief Fund, offering direct assistance to team members facing unexpected hardship 
Dining Credit: An annual dining credit to enjoy exceptional meals and experiences at any of our restaurants  
Dining Discount: A 51% dining discount across the entire USHG family of restaurants to share unforgettable meals with friends and loved ones  
Convenience & flexibility: Pre-tax commuter benefits for transit and parking 
Growth and community: Opportunities for learning, mentorship, and collaboration with some of the most passionate people in hospitality. 
Putting Enlightened Hospitality into Practice 
Integral to our culture are our six behaviors. Our behaviors guide how we work together.
We play to win with humble swagger. Hospitality is a team sport where everyone deserves an opportunity to thrive and belong

Write a great next chapter. The road to success is paved with mistakes well-handled
Bring a charitable assumption and err on the side of generosity
Leave our campsite better than we found it; always responsible for the impact of our wake

The responsibilities outlined above are not exhaustive. This role may be required to take on other duties or projects as necessary to support organizational goals, in alignment with their skills, experience, and the evolving needs of the business.

public.title: District Human Resources Manager (Hudson Valley, NY Market)
public.description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger. 
Candidates should reside within the Hudson Valley, NY market or surrounding areas, as this multi-site role provides support across multiple locations, including Wappingers Falls, West Nyack, Kingston, Mohegan Lake (Cortlandt), Nanuet, Poughkeepsie, Brewster, Leeds (Catskill), Fishkill, and Hawthorne (Mount Pleasant), New York. 
Position Purpose: 
The District Human Resources Manager (DHRM) is a key business partner responsible for driving talent readiness, associate engagement, compliance, and organizational effectiveness across a district of 6–13 stores. The DHRM aligns people strategies with business goals and Company Values, leading efforts in talent management, leadership development, associate relations, and workforce planning to build strong teams and sustain a positive, inclusive, and high-performing culture.
Key Responsibilities: 
10% Recruitment, Selection & Onboarding - Support Associate Support Department Supervisors (ASDS) selection and development, ensuring readiness for future leadership opportunities. Partner with store and district leaders to ensure quality and consistency in hiring and assimilation of both internal and external talent. Support hourly and salaried hiring initiatives, including local job fairs, internal development forums, and community partnerships. Oversee the onboarding experience for new leaders, ensuring timely system access, mentoring, and engagement in district learning plans.
40% Associate Relations & Workplace Culture - Lead HR Town Halls  and follow-up on action items from both townhalls and Voice of Associate survey results, ensuring accountability for progress and improvement. Partner with store leadership to foster engagement, recognition, and communication across teams. Serve as a trusted advisor and first responder for associate relations issues, workplace incidents, and investigations, partnering closely with AR and Legal as needed. Manage the accommodation process  for stores in their district by partnering with associates, leaders, and centralized resources to ensure timely documentation, consistent communication, and compliant return-to-work and accommodation plans that support associate wellbeing and business continuity. Manage Salesforce case investigations effectively, ensuring timely investigative documentation creation and retention, root-cause analysis, and fair resolution.
15% Change Leadership & Business Partnership - Promote and model Company Values and leadership behaviors, reinforcing a culture of inclusion, high-performance and customer focus. Actively participate in district operations and store walks to provide real-time HR insights and coaching. Partner with district leadership to align people strategies with business goals, driving results through talent, engagement, and organizational effectiveness. Support change initiatives such as new store openings, closings, restructurings, and strategic realignments.
15% Learning, Training & Performance Enablement - Leverage Salesforce, Workday and other HR tools to identify associate and leader skill gaps, and reinforce accountability for development outcomes. Monitor and assess the execution and impact of training plans for both hourly and salaried associates. Facilitate and model a culture of continuous learning, ensuring that coaching and skill development are embedded in daily operations. Partner with store leaders to ensure timely and effective performance management, including feedback delivery, code calibration, and development planning.
15% Operational Excellence & Collaboration - Maintain readiness and partnership protocols for labor relations and emergency response events. Participate in district meetings and business reviews as a key HR advisor and thought partner. Partner with the HR Service Center to ensure accuracy and consistency in staffing, transactions, and associate records. Leverage AI-enabled HR tools and people analytics (e.g., workforce trends, engagement, attendance, associate relations case drivers) to surface insights, anticipate risk, prioritize actions, and coach leaders on data-backed decisions that improve associate experience, compliance, and district performance. 
5% Talent Strategy & Leadership Development - Champion an inclusive, welcoming, and respectful workforce, leveraging local partnerships to continue building the most highly regarded culture in retail. Drive salaried succession planning and talent pipeline development through consistent talent planning and leadership evaluation. Partner with leaders to create individual development plans and facilitate meaningful career growth discussions.
Direct Manager/Direct Reports: 
DHRM position reports to a Regional HR Director.
6-13 ASDSs have a dotted-line reporting relationship to the DHRM.
Travel Requirements: 
Typically requires overnight travel 20% to 50% of the time.
Physical Requirements: 
Requires intermittent periods during which continuous physical exertion is required, such as walking, standing, stooping, climbing, lifting material or equipment, some of which may be heavy or awkward.
Working Conditions: 
Typically located in a comfortable indoor area. There may be regular exposure to mild physical discomfort from factors such as dust, fumes or odors, temperature extremes, loud noise, strong drafts, or bright lights.
Minimum Qualifications: 
Must be eighteen years of age or older.
Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.
Preferred Qualifications: 
No additional qualifications

The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a high school diploma and/or GED.

5

Minimum Leadership Experience:

None

Communicates Effectively
Decision Quality

public.title: Portfolio Manager
public.description:
We believe in the power and joy of learning 
At Cengage, our employees have a direct impact in helping learners around the world discover the power and joy of learning. We are bonded by our shared purpose – driving innovation that helps millions of learners improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education.
The Portfolio Manager (PM) is a Cengage School Portfolio Management Role at Cengage.
As the Portfolio Manager for Cengage School, you’ll lead a portfolio of market-leading educational products within Gale K12 School and Public Library markets. The PM develops product strategy by understanding the audience, analyzing the market and competitive trends, developing hypotheses, testing ideas in the market, processing data, and ultimately making strategic product decisions based on these insights and evidence. The PM leads product development, collaborating with team members to ensure on-time delivery of high-quality learning experiences. The PM clearly articulates the features and benefits of a product to the market, enabling the creation and delivery of compelling messaging for target audiences through measurable campaigns and programs. This role will support the Gale K12 (Science) portfolio in the School market, with some crossover into the Public Library space.
What you'll do here:
Lead a profitable product line by being responsible for the content strategy roadmap for the Gale K12 (Science) suite of products, inclusive of In Context, eBooks, and supplemental curriculum.
Provide product leadership, representing the portfolio and customers across audiences.
Use data to make market-informed business proposals, take mitigated risks, and guide strategic decisions.
Defines long-term goals based on research and trends, and sets metrics-driven milestones, making connections across datasets and courses to devise solutions to sophisticated business challenges
Balance experience, market knowledge, and insights to make impactful decisions and long-term plans.
Translate priorities into organized end-to-end strategic development plans with budgets, resources, performance goals, and key checkpoints.
Provide project team direction, facilitating effective communication, and ensuring timely delivery of multiple products simultaneously within scope and budget.
Cultivate an environment of creativity and collaboration.
Deliver quality learning experiences to students, instructors, and librarians.
Develop a deep understanding of competitors and an ability to anticipate competitor activity.
Identify and test product ideas within segments, including the administration of focus groups, advisory boards, reviews, and customer meetings as appropriate.
Regularly analyze product and portfolio plans to align forecasting and measurement of progress towards goals.
Work across teams with colleagues in Digital, Marketing, Sales, Content Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to set and implement the content strategy, and to ensure successful release of products in the marketplace.
Partner with colleagues in other functional areas on discipline-specific and pan-Cengage initiatives.
Make presentations at internal and external meetings and academic conventions in support of sales efforts and to drive sales.
Shares best practices across teams and functional groups.
Skills you will need here:
Creative and curious problem solving and collaboration
Understanding of the K12 educational technology and publishing industry, with a specific focus on Science
Ability to clearly articulate vision and strategy and help team members understand how their work impacts business success
Customer focus; understanding of how customer needs and challenges translate into opportunities
Demonstration of strong communication skills with keen ability to facilitate team meetings, presentations, focus groups, and interviews.
BA or BS Degree
Minimum 5 years in product management, product development, or other relevant portfolio management role
Cross-functional team leadership experience
Ability to inspire change through influence; honed social skills
Self-discipline with a high degree of accountability
Strong financial analysis and modeling skills and an understanding of business metrics
Natural curiosity and willingness to learn paired with a desire for continuous improvement
Proven written and verbal abilities enabling the preparation and presentation of information and recommendations to a diverse and senior level audience
Expected travel ~10% of time
Proficiency with Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Cengage is committed to working with broad talent pools to attract and hire strong and most qualified individuals. Our job applicants are considered regardless of any classification protected by applicable federal, state, provincial or local laws.
Cengage is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities including during our job application process. If you are an applicant with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in our job application process, please contact us at accommodations.ta@cengage.com .
About Cengage 
Cengage, a global education technology company serving millions of learners, provides affordable, quality digital products and services that equip students with the skills and competencies needed to be job ready. For more than 100 years, we have enabled the power and joy of learning with trusted, engaging content, and now, integrated digital platforms. We serve the higher education, workforce skills, secondary education, English language teaching and research markets worldwide. Through our scalable technology, including MindTap and Cengage Unlimited, we support all learners who seek to improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education.
Compensation 
At Cengage Group, we take great pride in our commitment to providing a comprehensive and rewarding Total Rewards package designed to support and empower our employees. Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards Philosophy .
The full base pay range has been provided for this position. Individual base pay will vary based on work schedule, qualifications, experience, internal equity, and geographic location.  Sales roles often incorporate a significant incentive compensation program beyond this base pay range.
In this position,  you will be eligible to participate in the company’s discretionary incentive bonus program.  This position's bonus target amount, which is not guaranteed and is dependent on individual performance and overall company results among other factors, is provided below.  
5% Annual: Individual Target  
$77,100.00 - $100,200.00 USD

public.title: HR Generalist
public.description:
Celebrating 85 Years of Building With Purpose 
At Absher Construction, we’re proud to celebrate over 85 years as one of the Pacific Northwest’s most respected general contractors. As a 100% employee-owned company, we believe our people are our greatest asset and we invest in them like it! From fully paid medical premiums for employees, to a generous PTO policy, 401(k) and ESOP retirement benefits, we offer a total rewards package that reflects the pride and ownership we bring to every project.
Absher Construction is looking for an experienced Human Resources Generalist to join our HR team in Puyallup! This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys the technical side of HR while still wanting to be a trusted resource for employees and leaders. You’ll have hands-on responsibility across benefits, leave administration, HRIS management, onboarding, compliance, employee relations, and investigations while helping us continue to improve how HR operates. We’re also in the middle of implementing ADP Workforce Now , so this person will play an important role in maintaining accurate employee information during the transition and helping us make better use of technology and more efficient HR processes going forward.
The HR Generalist reports to the Director of Human Resources and serves as a key resource for employees navigating benefits, leave, and other HR matters.
What You’ll Do
Manage employee onboarding and offboarding, including orientations, pre-employment requirements, employee changes, and craft employee processes
Maintain accurate employee records and HRIS information, including transfers, compensation changes, title changes, and other employee transactions
Administer employee benefit programs, including enrollments, qualifying changes, COBRA correspondence, carrier communication, billing reconciliation, and open enrollment
Support administration of 401(k) and ESOP plans, including employee changes, distributions, audit documentation, and compliance requirements
Administer protected leaves and workplace accommodations, including determining eligibility, maintaining documentation, monitoring leave usage, and communicating with employees and managers
Provide guidance to managers regarding performance management, documentation, progressive discipline, and performance improvement plans
Conduct employee relations investigations involving complaints, policy violations, harassment, discrimination, and other workplace concerns
Maintain compliance with I-9, E-Verify, employment laws, and company policies
Partner with Payroll to ensure employee transactions are processed accurately and on time
Support employee engagement initiatives, surveys, recognition programs, and communication efforts
Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes and improve workflows through technology
Assist with HR projects and other department needs as they arise
The role includes substantial ownership of HR administration and benefits, along with leave/accommodations, employee relations, compliance, and employee experience responsibilities.
What We’re Looking For
5+ years of related Human Resources experience
Strong working knowledge of employment laws and HR compliance requirements
Experience administering employee benefits
Strong knowledge of protected leave and accommodation processes
Experience supporting employee relations, investigations, and performance management
Strong HRIS experience; ADP Workforce Now experience is preferred
Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and SharePoint
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to build trust and rapport with employees and leaders at all levels
Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive matters
Comfortable learning new technology and identifying opportunities to improve processes
Bachelor’s degree or Human Resources certification preferred
Where This Role Can Go
We’re looking for someone who wants to continue developing their HR expertise and take on increasing responsibility over time. This role has the opportunity to grow into a Senior HR Generalist position and, longer term, into HR management .
What You Can Expect
You’ll join an HR team that values strong relationships, sound judgment, continuous improvement, and taking care of people. Absher’s core values guide how we work:
We care about people
We are servant leaders
We do things right
We do right things
Physical Requirements
This position is primarily performed in an office environment and requires frequent computer use and sitting, along with walking, standing, bending, and reaching. Occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds may be required. Employees must also be able to comply with applicable safety requirements when working in the office or visiting jobsites.
Salary offers are typically made between the entry and midpoint of the range and are based on factors such as experience, education, and internal equity.

$38.46 — $50.48 USD

public.title: VP of Quality Management
public.description: Overview By growing in every aspect of patient experience and quality, Catholic Health is becoming the most preferred choice on Long Island. From the bedside to the exam room to training and safety and every human moment in between — we’re dedicated to providing better care for our communities. Every patient. Every moment. That’s what it means to be dedicated to better. A member of Catholic Health, Good Samaritan University Hospital, is a non-profit 537- bed (including 100 nursing home beds) teaching hospital and a member of Catholic Health. With almost 900 physicians on staff, and a level I Trauma Center, we care for well over 100,000 patients annually across the south shore of Long Island. Our reputation for excellence is built on great choices and empowered leadership and fosters a team that is focused on evidence-based practice, continual learning and exceptional quality of care. Position Summary: The VP of QM and Accreditation is responsible for planning, developing, and implementing Performance Improvement initiatives.  He/she provides education and leadership on a facility-wide, multidisciplinary level for Operational/Leadership Rounding, FMEA, Six Sigma, and Lean Projects; collects and performs analyses of key performance measures and hospital wide data; leads the department heads in quality performance initiatives and activities in compliance with regulations and organizational mission and goals.  The VP directs the performance improvement activities associated with The Joint Commission standards; is responsible for the hospital-wide laboratory Joint Commission accreditation surveys; performs all functions of The Joint Commission Priority Focus Chair for Improving Organizational Performance and responds to evidence of standard compliance issues and complaints to The Joint Commission.  He/she provides oversight and coordination of data registries for the service lines in the hospital.  This position oversees the Quality Management Department personnel and activities and may include other tasks and responsibilities as assigned by the CMO to meet the needs of the organization. Job Details Comprehends and uses data for the analysis of PI results. Shares comprehendible reports in a timely fashion. Plans and develops policies, and processes for policies and forms. Works to develop meaningful PI measures for Clinical Contracts as well as monitoring performance data from those contracts. Represents GSHMC as appropriate to CHS and LIHN in the areas of Quality Management. Works with Director of Q.M and the Q.M. Staff in developing and sustaining PI projects to address the benchmark data from LIHN, Joint Commission CMS and DOH Measures and as well as other sources. Administers and oversees the auditing and entering of data into Registries. Administrator for the Adult Cardiac Surgery program, American College of Cardiology NCDR and the Transcather Valve Therapy (TVT).  Reports quality, performance improvement and contractual data to the CHS corporate Quality Meeting Committee. Directs the organizational preparation and reediness of the hospital and laboratory for Joint Commission accreditation. Leads the organizational Leadership/Operational Rounding and staff education on PI process such as PDSA. Oversees hospital wide Joint Commission Disease Specific Certifications and associated surveys. Directs the overall functions of the QM department. Develops and administers procedures for the systematic review and evaluation of the QM staff. Develops, updates and reviews policies and procedures for the department. Interviews and hires for appropriate staff positions. Remains current with H-CAHPS literature and communications. Serves as a root user for H-CAHPS reports. Recommends ways to disseminate patient satisfaction information. Analyzes trends in aggregate data and identifies strategies for improvement. Directs and develops facility-wide PI initiatives and projects utilizing PDSA, Lean, and Six Sigma. Demonstrates ability to move issues to resolution. Demonstrates the ability to communicate with all levels of staff in an effective and professional manner. Utilizes conflict resolution and negotiating skills to ensure timely resolution of issues. Serves as a resource person for staff, hospital personnel and physicians. Educates and coaches department directors in process improvement methods. Collaborates with department directors for the improvement of employee, physician and patient satisfaction. Organizational accreditation survey preparation and Joint Commission Function Chair for improving organizational performance. Accepts and performs other functions as requested by the CMO. Attends continuing education programs on-site and off-site. Maintains current knowledge of new hospital and departmental policies and procedures. Investigates and keeps current with trends and innovations in Quality Management design. Accepts and acts on constructive criticism. Maintains knowledge of current Joint Commission and CMS standards. Employee supervises and checks the work of staff. Employee is qualified by experience and/or credentials to prepare performance evaluations and competency assessments of staff. Provides leadership and direction in accordance with department goals and policies. Supports administrative decision and changes within the department. Supervises the training of new employees. Education:  Master’s Degree and or 5 years of experience in a healthcare setting. Experience: At least 5 years of administrative/clinical management experience.  Minimum of 5 years Quality or Performance Improvement experience. Knowledge of Outlook, Work, Excel, Database and Power Point required. Licensure/Certification: NYS Licensed Health Care Professional.  CPHQ and or CJCP strongly preferred. Preferred Qualifications: Excellent organization skills; detail oriented, credibility with physicians and professional staff, flexibility, dependability, problem solving ability, creativity, effective communication skills, data analytical skills, team building skills, ability to motivate, plan, organize and direct activities of others; must be flexible and able to work in stressful environment. Salary Range USD $300,000.00 - USD $385,000.00 /Yr. This range serves as a good faith estimate and actual pay will encompass a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience. The salary range or rate listed does not include any bonuses/incentive , differential pay or other forms of compensation that may be applicable to this job, and it does not include the value of benefits.
